The true form of the Ra-Blessed Felinid had emerged now that she found her master, going from a rogue monster to the beloved pet of a man she found worthy.
Her skin took on a strong shine as if she’d used some sort of tanning oil to make her body shine, transforming the already hot monster girl into a woman of irresistible charm.
Her sharp canines, once symbols of rebellion and independence, now gleamed with the promise of loyalty and newfound place in the world.
Where once stood a wild beast resisting fate now stood a radiant warrior, a beauty whose true self has been realized under her rightful master.
Bastet touched her own face as her eyes widened in sheer awe.
Not even she knew that she’d been suppressed up until now.
Not necessarily in her current power level, but future potential.
It felt like her future suddenly became brighter than ever, full of possibilities she could only dream about beforehand.
Master and pet leaned close, lost in each other’s eyes, embracing once more in a hungry kiss.
Despite Kaiden’s previous decision to stop, he was unable to resist the temptation.
A bond had been forged—one no force in the world could break.
As the pair was busy eating each other up, the world stirred.
Even if they hadn’t yet seen the broadcast, the big shots of the world would soon learn of what had transpired within this unassuming D-ranked dungeon.
History had been made.
For the first time since the mana apocalypse began, a human had tamed a monster.
His feat of defeating an A-ranked foe had already stirred curiosity in some, but that alone wasn’t enough to shake the foundations of power.
Not only was that feat much less significant, but the Blood Pact and ChronosX had suppressed the news to minimize its impact and the number of people it reached.
But this?
This was uncontrollable.
Government agencies would study the footage with religious fervor, seeking answers where they thought none existed previously.
Guilds would vie for his allegiance, hungry to claim the monster tamer for themselves.
Researchers would lose their minds at the mere thought of dissecting the mysteries of his new companion.
But beyond the scholars, the strategists, and the schemers...
To the common folk, he would become a symbol—a pioneer who had broken the limits of humanity itself.
An F-ranked nobody who made global news.
The airwaves would explode with speculation and wild theories, his name climbing the ranks of the most searched figures overnight.
And the Demonic Pornstar System, comfortably resting in Kaiden’s very soul?
It wouldfeast.
Some would hate him.
Some would love him.
But none would be able to ignore him.
And now, the world would answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Reaction of the World 1
paragraphs: The apartment was dim and quiet, save for the flickering lights and occasional cheering sound coming from a football game on the oversized flatscreen. Empty beer cans littered the hardwood floor, and a half-eaten bag of chips slumped against the armrest of the expensive leather couch. On that couch, a man snored softly. He was broad-shouldered, unshaven, and still wearing yesterday’s slacks.
*Click*

A sudden sound echoed through the air as the front door unlocked and opened. In stepped a beautiful woman clad in a sleek black suit. As she approached, her elegant heels clicked against the floor like the ticking of a countdown. Hip-length black hair framed her sharp, pale features, and mirrored shades shielded her eyes even though it was very early in the morning.
She took one look at the living room mess and sighed.
"Guild Master," she said firmly.
The man leading the famous high-tier Crimson Dominion guild, which was one of the few organizations in the US that could match the Ashborn family’s New Dawn’s power level and influence, didn’t move.
She approached the couch, leaned down, and tapped his forehead with two fingers in a rather forceful manner. "Sir. There’s an emergency call from the guild council. Your presence has been requested."

He groaned and stirred, waving her hand away after a beer-fueled burp, which made the woman grimace at her boss with eyes of pure disgust. "Hnnngh... What now? Did those damned Russians send another bomber for the president or somethin’?"
She shook her head. "That wouldn’t be important enough to warrant this meeting."
That finally got his attention.
One bleary eye cracked open. "... What?"

She straightened her spine, and after a brief search in her bag, she presented a bottle of luxurious perfume, which she sprayed right in her guild leader’s face. While the man was busy coughing and cursing her out of existence, she replied to his question with a perfect poker face. "Something happened in a dungeon. Something that’s never happened before."

"Unprecedented, huh?" he muttered after sending the woman a strong glare, which she accepted with a minute smirk. The guild master sighed before sitting up and scratching his beard. "Somebody solo a dragon? Find a legendary relic?"
She opened her tablet, brought up a video still, and turned it toward him.
"A man tamed a boss monster."
He blinked. "...Tamed?"

"Confirmed," she nodded. "Live footage that was uploaded to the Awakened Platform right after the stream ended without any edits or cuts being made to the footage. Title reads: ’Taming a Sexy Boss Monster.’"
He stared at the title for a long moment before his eyes sparkled with excitement.
"And the name?"
She hesitated, then answered. "Kaiden Grey."

A slow, knowing grin crept across the guild master’s lips as he leaned back into the couch, folding his arms behind his head. "Hah... Should’ve stayed in that stream instead of watchin’ this boring-ass football game and passing out like a... Never mind."
He sighed, but his beautiful and dutiful subordinate was happy to help him out. "Like a filthy homeless loser?"
"Miss Viera, your unreasonably harsh and spiteful attitude reminds me of my wife. I don’t like it."
She smiled ominously. "Well, she is my mother, after all."
"Oh... right."
Her ominous smile deepened as her eyes narrowed into fiery slits. A vein throbbed on her temple as she hissed, "Other guilds are already on the move, so how about we stop stalling for time, boss?"
"Right, right..."
With a heavy sigh, the football match on the screen was shut off. He stood and dressed, ready to have the meeting with his colleagues.
As he seated himself in his magically reinforced transportation vehicle, the guild master had an amused expression on his face. "This kid’s gonna turn the world upside down..."
Geneva, Switzerland – United Awakened Association (UAA) Headquarters

In a windowless chamber deep beneath the marble spires of Geneva, twelve hooded figures stood around a circular obsidian table. Each had irises glowing with different colors—one red, another golden, another glacial blue—representing the awakened titans of their nations.
A paused holographic display artifact shone a picture above the table: Kaiden with hand petting the hazy-eyed, purring Bastet right as her transformation was just beginning.
"This... breaks protocol," murmured the French delegate.
"Or creates a new one," countered the German envoy, leaning forward with his eyes narrowed, hoping to unveil some previously unnoticed detail in the video Kaiden had uploaded.
The High Warden of Records, a silver-haired woman with a metallic voice, nodded. "We will observe. Quietly. This event cannot go unmonitored."
Operation Oracle: Initiated.
Beijing – Crimson Dynasty War Room
In a sprawling chamber carved from red jade and reinforced steel, military officers and robed awakened generals stared at the obscene footage.
Grand Strategist Zhao snapped his ornate fan shut. "Bring me everything on Valhalla’s Sinners. Every mission, every member. I want his blood type, his school grades, his favorite goddamn food."
A junior officer hesitated. "Even if the US protects him?"
Zhao’s voice turned cold.
"Yes.
Colorado, USA – ARC Division Subterranean Facility
Deep beneath the Rocky Mountains, a sleek control room thrummed with power. A dozen operators stared at satellite feeds and biometric scans.
"Sir," one called. "Subject Kaiden Grey just tamed a boss-class monster. Footage uploaded globally."

An older man in a lab coat stood beside a massive wall display, rubbing his temple. "This man is a bundle of mystery... I have a feeling he’s either going to become the world’s greatest asset... or its greatest threat."
He turned. "Activate Project: Chimera Tamer. Full recon. No direct contact unless necessary."
A hatch opened below, and black-suited operatives slid into place.
London – European Guild Coalition HQ
A massive oak table sat in the middle of a regal hall, adorned with sigils from the major guilds: Excalibur, Valkyrie Order, Duskborn, and more.
"We call first rights," shouted a Valkyrie rep. "He and his ladies perfectly suit our aesthetic and branding!"

"You mean you want to dress them in feathers to have them model in your damned papers?" scoffed Excalibur’s silver-haired tactician. "We offer power and purpose, not just fame in the damned fashion industry."

The woman was about to lunge at the man for his infuriating statement when another voice sounded. A sultry, feminine one. "You two will just scare him away," purred Duskborn’s envoy. "Let the shadows guide him to us."
A war of words ensued.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Reaction of the World 2
paragraphs: Kyoto – Shogunate Circle Shrine
In a tranquil garden framed by cherry blossoms, an elderly monk watched the footage on a floating crystal orb while sipping tea.
"To tame a beast... is to tame fate itself," he murmured.
Behind him, a shrine maiden in a white and red kimono bowed.
"Shall I prepare for travel, Master?"
He nodded.
His gaze lingered on the orb a moment longer, eyes filled with reverence. "The old prophecies stir. The Kami will awaken if he continues down this path," he whispered.
Cairo – Relic Guard Citadel
In a citadel hidden beneath a sandstorm and shielded by hieroglyphic enchantments, ancient scholars rewound the footage on holographic tablets. Whispered chants filled the air.
"This is it," an archivist whispered. "The union of spirit and beast, foretold by the Scrolls of Al-Mutasim."
Warlord Abbas, adorned in obsidian-scaled armor, turned to his elite desert-runners.
"Find him. Trade. Threaten. Beg. Whatever it takes." He raised a clenched fist. "If we fail to act, another nation will bind his power to their cause before the sun rises again."
South Africa – Soulbound Consortium
Drums echoed as tribal elders and awakened shamans sat in a stone circle.
"The ancestors whisper," said one, eyes rolled back. "This boy... this Kaiden... he walks the line between spirit and beast."
A lion-masked woman stepped forward. "Should we summon him?"
"No," said the eldest. "He will come... or he will not. But when he does, we must be ready."
Global Scientific Community – Halls of Madness
Within ivory towers and hidden labs, scholars descended into chaos.
"Sympath Core theory: revived!"
"Can emotion-based taming protocols be replicated?"
"Arousal magic, theoretical no longer!"
One researcher screamed in joy while another wept. A university began prepping grants before breakfast.
Blood Pact – Private Chamber
Victor Thorne lounged lazily in a velvet chair, sipping wine.
His assistant, Olga, stood nearby. "The boy who beat that dumbass A-tier... What was his name again?"
Olga dutifully answered. "David. Kaiden Grey is also the man whose girl B-tier Theodore tried to kidnap."
He raised a brow. "The one we paid to bail out of prison?"
She nodded.
"Keep watching," he said, voice like velvet over a blade.
Beast Apocalypse – Auction House
In a dark, opulent room, the masked heads of the Beast Apocalypse’s inner circle leaned in.
"His DNA," said one. "Acquire it."
"His monster companion," whispered another. "Would fetch trillions."
They tapped their glasses. "Send in the collectors."
In many homes - all accross the globe
TV screens flickered as the Global Awakened News logo blazed into existence with dramatic music rising in the background. The header read:
BREAKING: HISTORIC TAME EVENT IN D-RANK DUNGEON – F-RANK AWAKENED SHOCKS THE WORLD

The view cut to an elegant news desk. Sitting behind it was a pretty reporter with blonde curls, flawless makeup, and a pristine navy-blue blazer with a golden Global Awakened News insignia pinned to her chest. Despite her professional demeanor, a faint blush was already forming on her cheeks.
"Good evening," she began with a smooth and practiced voice. "I’m Melanie Cross, and we interrupt all programming to bring you an unprecedented development in the awakened world."
A replay appeared in the top right of the screen, showing Kaiden and his group fighting Bastet.

"At approximately 6:43 AM UTC-5, inside a D-ranked dungeon in the United States, a confrontation between an F-rank awakened individual and a boss-class monster was captured in full and uploaded publicly to the Awakened Platform."

She paused for a brief moment before resuming. "While defeating a boss monster is a great feat, what followed after has never occurred in recorded history, despite the many attempts that have been made."

A new feed rolled, displaying Kaiden leaping with his raised axe alongside Luna’s storm magic buzzing right next to him, [Stormblade] in hand. The action was epic and cleanly cut, with dramatic narration by Melanie.

"Despite his low rank, the awakened individual known as Kaiden Grey coordinated an assault with his three female teammates of Valhalla’s Sinners and with the members of the low-tier guild they were doing mercenary work for called Nova Circuit, culminating in a critical blow to the boss monster, officially known by the name ’Bastet the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh.’"
Melanie nodded toward the camera.
"Experts are still analyzing the combat footage. But that is not the reason this video has sparked an international frenzy."
The feed changed. Onscreen, Bastet staggered, falling to her knees. Kaiden approached. Melanie looked down at her notes, then cleared her throat.
"Following the battle... u-uh... Kaiden Grey proceeded to—um—initiate a... non-hostile subjugation technique."
The screen behind her awkwardly cut to a static "Global Awakened News – Content Restricted" logo.

Melanie blinked twice, flustered. "Ahem. The footage—due to broadcasting guidelines—has been partially censored. However... We can confirm that Kaiden used a, er... unique ’taming’ method previously thought to be nothing more than perverted men living out their sadistic fantasies."
A cough came from off-camera.
"Bastet, the boss monster... changed form shortly after this... encounter. Into what appears to be a more humanoid... variant of her monster form with a few catlike traits."
A silhouette of Bastet’s new form appeared on the screen, with a note that read "Censored for National Broadcast" in the corner.
Melanie shifted uncomfortably in her seat.
"Further footage shows... displays of emotional bonding. Um. Close physical proximity. Extended... k-kissing."

She pressed forward, cheeks now visibly pink. "As of now, Kaiden Grey has become the first recorded awakened to successfully tame a monster—boss-class or otherwise—through what we dubbed as a ’Companionship Contract.’"
She was referencing the promises Kaiden made to Bastet, such as showering him in his affection every day if she were to accept him as her master, which she did after some encouragement.

"Global authorities are scrambling to determine the implications of this act. Government councils, guild coalitions, and major factions have already begun reacting. We are expecting an official statement from the United Awakened Association within the hour."
She glanced off-camera. A voice in her earpiece mumbled something.
Melanie winced. "Ah—yes. Additionally, the original video was titled, quote, ’Taming a Sexy Boss Monster’—and, um, remains the top trending video globally."
Melanie quickly waved, trying to push her embarrassment away physically.

"W-We’ll continue to update you as more information becomes available. For now, this is Melanie Cross with Global Awakened News, signing off with the hope that all future dungeon explorations remain... professional."

She looked into the camera, visibly mortified but holding composure like a champ. It was evident in her wry eyes that she knew many would attempt to replicate Kaiden’s methodology in hopes of successful monster taming.

Naturally, Global Awakened News wasn’t the only news station to cover this topic. But they were the biggest news channel in the world, translated into all languages. Them featuring Kaiden and even mentioning that there was a video under the handle Valhalla’s Sinners had great consequences.
CNN ran a special: "Monster Love or Magical Threat?"
Fox: "Is Humanity Under Monster Seduction?"
X exploded:
#MonsterTamer 🔥
#Kaiden4Kami
#SexyBossMonster
#TannedKitten
Many fan art of Kaiden and Bastet in every position imaginable spread all over the internet.
Theories that bordered on pure conspiracies were created one after the other:
"He’s an alien masquerading around in the skin of a human!"
"He’s from a different timeline, a time traveler who came back from the future!"
"This is IRL monster hentai. Tentacles where?"
All that is to say... Kaiden Grey and Valhalla’s Sinners were no longer an obscure little group of hopeful rookies.

paragraphs: [Ding!]
[You’ve subjugated a Re-Blessed Felinid, Bastet (Level 20).]
[Subjugated monster girls: 1/3]

As the system’s notifications rang in his mind, Kaiden knew his life was going to be changed forever. He debated if broadcasting this, or even doing it in the first place, was a smart idea, and even now, he wasn’t certain.

All he knew was that he and his girls harbored big dreams, and each of them was willing to undertake great risks to get there. They’d already decided they would live the lives of stars instead of hiding away in the shadows, slowly, measuredly accumulating their strength with calculated steps.
Doing so wasn’t the ideal path in their opinion, for their power was to be derived from ranking up the system. Simply leveling up wasn’t enough.
Speaking of...
[To rank the system up to the third rank, the host needs to reach...]
[Views: 100 million]
[Fangirls: 5,000]
[Income: 10,000]
*Pahh!*
With a rather obscene sound, his tongue and lips detached from Bastet’s, who was busy spooning against his member with great desperation.
"We gotta get dressed, Bastet. It’s time to leave."
"Must we...?" she whimpered while latching her arms around his neck and legs around his waist, refusing to let go. "Also, what do you mean leave? Leave where?"
Kaiden observed her keenly for a brief moment, finding her statement strange, before sighing. "We’ll discuss it later. We can’t delay any longer."

"Yes, Master..." Bastet purred with a sad tone, but hearing the urgency in his voice, the Ra-Blessed Felinid knew time was of the essence. As such, she only nuzzled her face against his for a few brief seconds before letting go and climbing off.

Kaiden thanked the viewers for watching and assured them they’d be back with more content soon enough before ending the broadcast. He didn’t bother editing the boss encounter, knowing full well people will be demanding the full tape soon enough, anyhow. If that wasn’t enough of a reason, the fact that this video was hour-long and counted as adult content meant that the longer duration would help him farm stats for the system better.
He observed his current stats.
[Views: 1.4 million]
[Fangirls: 111]
[Income: 222]
Kaiden was brought out of his thoughts when Jack shouted at him angrily. "What the fuck, man?! Now there’s no boss monster loot or XP! How do you plan to reimburse us all?"

A portal opened right as he finished his accusation, signaling the cleared status of the dungeon. Such portals opened in the boss chambers after the monster fell. In this case, that didn’t happen. But Bastet did indeed fall, just in a different manner... Kaiden theorized that she was no longer considered a monster but a free entity like any other human from Earth, no longer locked in the dungeon. She became a normal person, just with a different race instead of human.

But Jack was right. Kaiden’s method of defeating Bastet didn’t reward any of them with XP or loot. As for monster loot, well, this dungeon plain sucked. Virgin dungeons like this one were highly sought after because the first time a monster was defeated, they had a small chance to drop items after dematerializing. Once they respawned, the loot would not be dropped.

However, this dungeon was a horrible source of monster loot drops. Mainly because this dungeon’s main challenge wasn’t even the monsters found inside but the extreme heat of the desert biome. The scorching sun itself almost ended the dungeon descent.
The second reason was that for a D-rank dungeon, there weren’t too many monsters present. It was likely that the environment itself played a role in its high difficulty setting.

Thirdly, the loot that did drop was basically junk trash. Some weren’t even worthy enough to be picked up by the dungeon aides. And as two out of four helpers fell, the valuables they had been carrying were lost alongside their lives.

All that is to say, the haul of this dungeon was horrendous. 9 lives were lost, while Leon and Dorothy suffered life-threatening wounds. Jack and the others hoped the monster would drop a fancy gearset, weapon, or other artifact while granting them multiple levels’ worth of XP for their troubles.
Based on Bastet’s high difficulty, that was likely indeed the case, but...
"Sucks to be you, I suppose," Luna sneered. She hated Nova Circuit’s members with a burning passion. To be more precise, Jack, Vaelira, and Sasha were the ones she was beefing with.

The blonde-haired, A-tier Arcane Puppeteer didn’t like what she was hearing. She straightened her spine after administering first aid to Dorothy and looked at the purple-haired girl with a strong glare. "I’m afraid this won’t pass."

"Now, now..." Nyx purred with a sly smile. "Your guild leader, Tessa, promised us a third of the haul as payment for our services, alongside reimbursing us for any gear that got damaged during the dungeon clear. Being the magnanimous group of people we are, Valhalla’s Sinners are prepared to donate our share of the loot to Nova Circuit."
She made a dramatic pause, placing a thoughtful finger on her cheek. "We’ll even waive our reimbursement, out of the kindness of our hearts."
Luna snorted, knowing full well that Nyx was enjoying this way too much.
The pink-haired, curvaceous bombshell of a woman continued with a honeyed tone. "In return, we’ll just be taking one thing. A small souvenir. A single piece of the dungeon."

Her eyes gleamed with glee as she raised a hand and gestured toward Bastet, who stood beside Kaiden with her arms crossed in front of her chest and her tail swishing lazily behind her. She was observing the conversation with obvious confusion, not understanding what they were talking about.
"We’ll take her. Bastet will be our cut."

Sasha scoffed with annoyance, flipping her fiery red hair over her shoulder as she stomped on the sandy floor of the boss chamber. "Oh, please! That’s not a deal but an extortion wrapped in sweet honey. Especially when none of your armor is worth more than garbage-tier scrap. Common-rarity junk. And the monsters? Didn’t drop a damn thing of value."
She smirked as if she’d just laid down the trump card. "You want fair? Sell the boss monster. Two-thirds of the profit goes to us, and you keep a third."

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Aria Has Had Enough
paragraphs: Kaiden’s eyes narrowed. His mouth opened, ready to tell Sasha exactly where she could shove her suggestion. But before he could utter a word, Aria’s voice cut through the tension like a razor blade dipped in frost. Her usual serenity was nowhere to be seen.
"Enough."
Everyone turned toward the Moon Valkyrie, whose silver-blue eyes now gleamed with a steely light.
"I’m so glad to hear your opinions," Aria said in a polite, composed, but very chilling tone. "But let’s remind ourselves of one thing. You’re rookies."
Sasha blinked, confused. "Excuse me?"
"You’re rookie members of Nova Circuit," Aria explained. "The agreement made wasn’t between you, Sasha. Nor you, Vaelira. Certainly not you, Jack."
Her gaze passed over each of them slowly, staring into their eyes.
"The deal was struck between Valhalla’s Sinners and Tessa, the leader of your guild."

She tilted her head to the side as a hostile edge seeped into her expression. "Unless one of you has suddenly become guild master or been granted the right to negotiate on behalf of Nova Circuit, your opinions are meaningless. You are owed nothing."
Once done with her statement, Aria smiled, but the friendly gesture didn’t reach her eyes.

There was a heavy silence that descended as a result of the Moon Valkyrie’s cold declaration. Jack’s jaw clenched, Vaelira’s brows twitched in irritation, and Sasha looked like she had something more to say.
Nyx clapped her hands together with a giant grin adorning her delicate lips. "What my icy sis said~."
Luna just cracked her knuckles, fully agreeing with her silver-haired friend.

"Let’s leave before your fellow guild members succumb to their wounds," Kaiden suggested, happy his girls had grown such a backbone in this short amount of time. They were bravely standing up to strong combatants who would’ve easily killed them mere days ago.

"You’re one to say..." Leon growled with spite before gesturing toward both of his ruined arms with his chin. "I would’ve long been in the hand of the professionals awaiting our exit outside if you hadn’t decided to dick down that monster chick and just killed her."

Kaiden eyed the heavily bleeding man whose features contorted with overwhelming pain. He knew the accusation had quite a lot of merit to it, but he just shrugged his shoulders. "A man’s gotta do what a man’s gotta do."

A heavy cursing spree was the answer he received from the wounded swordsman, but the Paragon of Sin turned on his heels and began walking toward the swirling portal, accompanied by the three merrily giggling lady companions of his who were very amused with his shameless audacity.
Bastet also walked after her new master with worried steps, visibly concerned with both the portal and just what was going on in general.
Sensing her overwhelmed state of mind, Nyx stopped before reaching the portal and extended a hand toward her. She smiled encouragingly while saying, "Come, Bastet. We’ll show you your new home."

The pink-haired Valkyrie watched with a deadpan expression as their man left without checking on this slightly panicked girl. However, she quickly recovered. "Your new master/lover might seem to be a bit...sharp around the edgesat times, but trust me, Kaiden is the most considerate man when it comes to his girls... I believe you will love your time with our family."

The tanned woman observed Nyx for a bit before shaking her head. "I feel like I’m being treated like a little baby... I’m not concerned about his love for me, I just don’t like this strange door. I don’t want to step into it."

"Oh!" Nyx gasped. She knew it already, but it was rather hard to tell her brain that she was indeed conversing with a monster. Or, well, an ex-monster, perhaps. It was only natural Bastet wouldn’t want to step into the gate as she hadn’t seen it before.
"We don’t really know what this is either, but you should think of it as an interdimensional portal capable of traversing through realities in the blink of an eye—or something like that."
"What language are you speaking?" Bastet deadpanned.
"Come, let’s go," Nyx said with a rather fake smile, knowing this explanation would take a very long time.

*Hiss!* Bastet hissed and growled at the portal the closer she came. But when Kaiden returned and pulled her up into a bridal carry, her consent was no longer asked. Cutely closing her eyes and gripping onto her master with all her strength, the Ra-Blessed Felinid found herself on Earth.

She was the first ever monster that wasn’t attacked on sight upon stepping out of the portal, save for the monsters that were restrained and brought out to be killed outside the dungeons so as to eat their meat. Inside the dungeon, they would’ve dematerialized upon their deaths, but the same wasn’t true for when their slaughter happened on Earth.

"Welcome back..." Tessa’s greetings heralded Valhalla’s Sinners’ official return to Earth. The black-haired woman sounded troubled. Not only was she shocked by what she’d seen both on his stream and in his arms right now, but her already struggling guild lost nine awakened during the undertaking.
Her life wasn’t an easy one.
"It’s good to see you again, Tessa," Kaiden replied amicably.
The rest of the survivors followed after them, bringing the injured to the awaiting medical staff, who immediately began tending to them.

"Mind if I accompany you guys on the way back?" Tessa asked. It seemed she had some business to discuss, as she instructed her subordinates, the instructors, to remain with the others. She then gestured to one of the awaiting minivans.
Kaiden and the squad didn’t have a ride, so they were more than happy to accept her offer.
"Will you come with us?" Kaiden asked after turning toward Elara, the teenage dungeon aide who accompanied them on this trying adventure.

"M-me? Why?" Her meek attitude returned now that she was out of the dungeon. Back during the critical moments of the dungeon descent, she was incredibly reliable. But it seemed she was a rather awkward girl during times of peace—or at least when it came to interacting with others—she seemed awkward and withdrawn.
"I would like to discuss something with you."
Instead of replying, the girl looked at Tessa. The woman nodded, permitting it. "Put down your bags. The others will take care of everything."
"Yes, Leader!"
And just like that, it was time to go home, where, once they got nice and comfy, it would be time to check their latest video’s numbers!
It will be like never before!

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Going Home
paragraphs: The loud engine of the minibus filled the silence as it rolled over the cracked, sun-beaten road that led away from the dungeon site. Inside, the atmosphere was quiet, butveryfar from peaceful.
Seven passengers rode in the vehicle’s back cabin, seated on the bench-style seats that faced one another.

Kaiden sat right in the center of the left row. Luna leaned against his shoulder on his left. Her arms were folded in front of her delicate chest, and a thoughtful look occupied her face. On his right, however, lay a sight far less composed.

Bastet, the tanned and temptingly curvy feline, had chosen not to sit like the rest of them. Instead, she lay with her head comfortably nestled in Kaiden’s lap and her thick, lush tail lazily flicking up to brush against his face, shoulder, and occasionally his ear with playful, suggestive strokes. Her purring was loud—constant—and it vibrated rather strongly through his lower half.

Her amber eyes shone with obvious mischief, and while she didn’t say a word, her every movement made her desires abundantly clear. A low, pleased sigh left her lips every so often as she nuzzled against him, one arm draped possessively across his waist. Everyone here understood painfully well that she was currently trying to seduce Kaiden with a reserved but sensual mating call.
Kaiden, to his credit, kept his expression neutral, though a light twitch at the corner of his mouth hinted at his inner battle. She wasn’t even being subtle.

Across from him sat Tessa. Her expression was unreadable as she watched the display with professional detachment—or at least attempted to. Her dark eyes occasionally flicked to Bastet, then to Kaiden, and then away again, as if trying to calculate something.
To Tessa’s left sat Nyx and Aria, both watching the feline with very different energies.

Nyx wore a sly, amused smirk. She rested her chin in her hand, looking like someone watching a cat try to flirt with the lion’s pride leader in front of his lionesses. Her eyes sparkled with amusement every time Bastet’s tail batted at Kaiden’s cheek, and she seemed to be genuinely entertained by the reactions of the others.
Aria, on the other hand, wasn’t hiding her thoughts quite so well. She didn’t seem to be trying to.

Her silver brows were furrowed. Her arms were crossed, and her normally serene aura had a sharp edge to it. She wasn’t glaring—yet—but her eyes were fixed on Bastet like she was watching a rival move into her territory. She didn’t speak, but there was an unmistakable air of disapproval brewing beneath her silence.
Just like the Moon Valkyrie, the Storm Valkyrie didn’t appreciate Bastet’s antics much at all, best evidenced by her occasional, cute "Hpmh!" sounds.

To Tessa’s right sat Elara, perched on the edge of her seat like she didn’t quite know how to sit. The teenage dungeon aide kept her gaze low, hands folded tightly in her lap, doing everything she could to avoid looking directly at Bastet—or Kaiden, for that matter. The slight red tint on her ears betrayed her thoughts, and she seemed wholly unprepared to be part of whatever... this was.

Meanwhile, Bastet continued her antics unabated. Her purrs were a low, smug vibration that filled the cabin. It was evident that even if she sensed the hostile stares sent her way by the two possessive girlfriends, she didn’t give a single damn. Every now and then, she even pressed closer to Kaiden’s stomach and whispered something under her breath in a husky, needy tone. His expression barely shifted, but that was enough for Luna to sigh heavily at his side.
Aria’s gaze narrowed even further as she asked in a cold tone, "You just finished copulating with Kai. Shouldn’t you relax for a bit?"
"No~?" Bastet purred. Her dismissive, one-word reply only served to irk the silver-haired beauty even further.
"You just entered a new world full of wonders your desert never had, yet you aren’t even looking out the window," Luna said.
"Alrighty, let’s abandon this topic for now," Kaiden muttered. His voice was calm but firm, serving as an anchor in the suddenly choppy emotional waters inside the minibus.

Without missing a beat, he reached behind Luna and gently raked his fingers through her flowing purple hair. The gesture was soft and casual, but it struck like lightning. Luna’s irritation melted with stunning speed, her previously furrowed brow relaxing as her eyes fluttered closed and she leaned into his touch.

At the same time, Kaiden subtly stretched his left leg forward, placing it between Aria’s limbs. The silver-haired Valkyrie didn’t hesitate. Like a starved serpent finding its meal at last, her slender legs instinctively moved to trap his with hers in a possessive lock. The tension in her shoulders vanished immediately, and a faint pink hue dusted her cheeks, but her expression remained composed. Only the death of the fire in her previously sharp gaze betrayed how deeply the simple contact had affected her.

Nyx couldn’t help but giggle. She cupped her cheek with one hand and leaned against the minibus wall with the other, clearly entertained. "You two are getting trained very well..." she whispered with a smirk.

"Shut up, you dumb bimbo. I don’t want to hear your voice right now..." Luna muttered while sending a death stare toward Nyx’s heavily bobbing breasts every time their vehicle came into contact with the minutest of bumps. She scoffed, "Even the scorching desert heat and the relentless burning of the sun wasn’t enough to make you shed your giant fat reserves... You damned pink camel."

"I love you too, bestie," Nyx purred in response. She was way too pleased with her first dungeon clear to get into a catfight. The curvaceous beauty earned herself a strong scoff from the Storm Valkyrie.
Tessa raised an eyebrow. The way these five acted was vastly different than what she was used to in any awakened setting. They seemed... so incredibly free.

Luna leaned against his shoulder on his left.

On his right, however, lay a sight far less composed.
Bastet, the tanned and temptingly curvy feline, had chosen not to sit like the rest of them.

Instead, she lay with her head comfortably nestled in Kaiden’s lap and her thick, lush tail lazily flicking up to brush against his face, shoulder, and occasionally his ear with playful, suggestive strokes.
Her purring was loud—constant—and it vibrated rather strongly through his lower half.
Her amber eyes shone with obvious mischief, and while she didn’t say a word, her every movement made her desires abundantly clear.
A low, pleased sigh left her lips every so often as she nuzzled against him, one arm draped possessively across his waist.
Everyone here understood painfully well that she was currently trying to seduce Kaiden with a reserved but sensual mating call.
Kaiden, to his credit, kept his expression neutral, though a light twitch at the corner of his mouth hinted at his inner battle.
She wasn’t even being subtle.
Across from him sat Tessa.
Her expression was unreadable as she watched the display with professional detachment—or at least attempted to.
Her dark eyes occasionally flicked to Bastet, then to Kaiden, and then away again, as if trying to calculate something.
To Tessa’s left sat Nyx and Aria, both watching the feline with very different energies.
Nyx wore a sly, amused smirk.
She rested her chin in her hand, looking like someone watching a cat try to flirt with the lion’s pride leader in front of his lionesses.
Her eyes sparkled with amusement every time Bastet’s tail batted at Kaiden’s cheek, and she seemed to be genuinely entertained by the reactions of the others.
Aria, on the other hand, wasn’t hiding her thoughts quite so well.
She didn’t seem to be trying to.
Her silver brows were furrowed.
Her arms were crossed, and her normally serene aura had a sharp edge to it.
She wasn’t glaring—yet—but her eyes were fixed on Bastet like she was watching a rival move into her territory.
She didn’t speak, but there was an unmistakable air of disapproval brewing beneath her silence.
Just like the Moon Valkyrie, the Storm Valkyrie didn’t appreciate Bastet’s antics much at all, best evidenced by her occasional, cute "Hpmh!" sounds.
To Tessa’s right sat Elara, perched on the edge of her seat like she didn’t quite know how to sit.
The teenage dungeon aide kept her gaze low, hands folded tightly in her lap, doing everything she could to avoid looking directly at Bastet—or Kaiden, for that matter.
The slight red tint on her ears betrayed her thoughts, and she seemed wholly unprepared to be part of whatever... this was.
Meanwhile, Bastet continued her antics unabated.
Her purrs were a low, smug vibration that filled the cabin.
It was evident that even if she sensed the hostile stares sent her way by the two possessive girlfriends, she didn’t give a single damn.
Every now and then, she even pressed closer to Kaiden’s stomach and whispered something under her breath in a husky, needy tone.
His expression barely shifted, but that was enough for Luna to sigh heavily at his side.
Aria’s gaze narrowed even further as she asked in a cold tone, "You just finished copulating with Kai.
Shouldn’t you relax for a bit?"
"No~?" Bastet purred.
Her dismissive, one-word reply only served to irk the silver-haired beauty even further.
"You just entered a new world full of wonders your desert never had, yet you aren’t even looking out the window," Luna said.
"Alrighty, let’s abandon this topic for now," Kaiden muttered.
His voice was calm but firm, serving as an anchor in the suddenly choppy emotional waters inside the minibus.
Without missing a beat, he reached behind Luna and gently raked his fingers through her flowing purple hair.
The gesture was soft and casual, but it struck like lightning.
Luna’s irritation melted with stunning speed, her previously furrowed brow relaxing as her eyes fluttered closed and she leaned into his touch.
At the same time, Kaiden subtly stretched his left leg forward, placing it between Aria’s limbs.
The silver-haired Valkyrie didn’t hesitate.
Like a starved serpent finding its meal at last, her slender legs instinctively moved to trap his with hers in a possessive lock.
The tension in her shoulders vanished immediately, and a faint pink hue dusted her cheeks, but her expression remained composed.
Only the death of the fire in her previously sharp gaze betrayed how deeply the simple contact had affected her.
Nyx couldn’t help but giggle.
She cupped her cheek with one hand and leaned against the minibus wall with the other, clearly entertained.
"You two are getting trained very well..." she whispered with a smirk.
"Shut up, you dumb bimbo.
I don’t want to hear your voice right now..." Luna muttered while sending a death stare toward Nyx’s heavily bobbing breasts every time their vehicle came into contact with the minutest of bumps.
She scoffed, "Even the scorching desert heat and the relentless burning of the sun wasn’t enough to make you shed your giant fat reserves...
You damned pink camel."
"I love you too, bestie," Nyx purred in response.
She was way too pleased with her first dungeon clear to get into a catfight.
The curvaceous beauty earned herself a strong scoff from the Storm Valkyrie.
Tessa raised an eyebrow.
The way these five acted was vastly different than what she was used to in any awakened setting.
They seemed... so incredibly free.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Buying a Teenage Girl
paragraphs: Elara, meanwhile, blinked. One after the other.

The timid girl had remained quiet throughout the exchange, pretending to focus on the floor, but her eyes crept up toward Kaiden with a look of badly disguised wonder. Her gaze lingered on his hand stroking Luna’s hair, then dropped to his leg, caught between Aria’s, before settling on his face.

And for the first time since they’d met, she looked at him not as an awakened, nor as some controversial streamer... but as a man in control. Her face turned a deeper shade of red, and she quickly looked away again.
"So..." Tessa spoke up all of a sudden. She had a downcast look. "I would like to sincerely apologize for the behavior of my guild members."
Silence descended on the interior of the minivan, save for Bastet’s incessant purring. The members of Valhalla’s Sinners exchanged glances with each other.
"The way your junior subordinates behaved is straight-up unacceptable, Miss Tessa," Aria declared.

Luna had a few words of her own to add. "Yeah, and they not only knew that we were filming throughout the clear, but that blonde bitch herself broadcasted it all. The fact that they acted as they did with that knowledge in mind doesn’t paint the Nova Circuit guild in a good light at all."

"Haaah..." Tessa sighed with dejection, and suddenly, the black, exhausted circles under her eyes became very accentuated. She nodded. "Yes, I’m aware. I don’t expect you to forgive us. All I can do is promise we’ll evaluate this dungeon dive strictly and mete out punishments where applicable."
"That Vaelira woman is giving you a lot of trouble, hm?" Nyx mused with a friendly tone. She liked this guild leader on a personal level quite a lot.

"As a guild leader, I won’t be badmouthing my subordinates. But... If you guys want to have a relatively stress-free life, I can’t recommend becoming guild masters." She chuckled dryly at her own misery.

They all understood what was going on. Throughout the clear, the prowess of Valhalla’s Sinners was shown off greatly. Tessa, who is doing her utmost to make her fallen guild rise again, wanted to retain friendly relations with a promising upstart group like them so that she may call on them again in the future.
Many of the most prominent mercenaries would refuse to work with a guild like Nova Circuit after such a disaster of a dungeon clear.
And, frankly, Kaiden felt the same.

Tessa was a nice woman, sure, but her capabilities to rein her subordinates in were subpar at best. Despite her promise to ’mete out punishments,’ they all knew Vaelira would get a minor slap on the wrist at best. As the sole A-tier awakened of the guild, she was basically untouchable for fear of her just up and walking away from the org.

But, at the same time, Kaiden was also an opportunist. He knew when to be amicable. Nova Circuit was the sole guild they had any sort of relationship with, and knowing how arduous their future would be now that the Bastet subjugation video was out, they could use all the allies they could get their hands on.

As such, he addressed Tessa. "We understand how difficult your job is, Tessa. Although Nova Circuit has greatly disappointed us, you were also the guild who saw potential in us when no one else did. We’ll not close any doors with you if you agree not to stir trouble regarding the division of dungeon loot. We want Bastet, nothing else."
"I’m not loot..." Bastet grumbled with dissatisfaction.

"Of course," Tessa sighed with relief, and a happy smile crept onto her lips as the weight on her shoulders lessened. "I can already see that she likes you guys. I have four cats at home, and I love all of them. I can’t imagine how it would feel to get them taken from me."
"I’m not a cat!" Bastet hissed with a much stronger tone this time around.
"Great," Kaiden said with a nod of his head, ignoring the distraught kitten in his lap, save for the calming stroking of her lush dark hair.
His head then turned toward the sole underage person present and declared without any further fanfare:
"I want to buy Elara."
"Huh?!" the girl in question yelped with utmost shock.
Tessa raised an eyebrow, alongside Luna and Aria. Nyx only smiled at her man proudly. She had a feeling it would be like this.

"Elara, you not only helped us get through this the ordeal, but you also saved Aria and Nyx when the sandstorm hit us. If you hadn’t anchored them down with your strength, who knows if they would still be with us... As such, I want to repay our debt by buying your contract and setting you free," Kaiden explained.

Nyx nodded at her boyfriend, taking over the mantle of conversation. "A girl your age should be worried about getting good grades in school and scoring a handsome boyfriend, not running around in dungeons while carrying weighty backpacks and being in danger all the time."
"B-but I was only doing my job! You owe me nothing! We’ve been trained to know that saving combatants, even if it costs us our lives, is our duty. And the fees are very high...!"
"How high?" Aria asked, joining in on the conversation now that she got the gist of what was going on.
"T-the buyout fee is a 100 C-Chronos to Titanforge and whatever amount you agree to with Miss Tessa..."
Titanforge was the training company that made her into a capable dungeon aide, while Nova Circuit was the one who paid 10 Chronos to buy her services.
110 Chronos, or $11,000... That was a hefty asking price.

"I’ll waive our part of the fee. Truth be told, I’ve been very guilty about your presence in our guild..." Tessa muttered with ashen, guilty eyes before growling, "It was a hiring manager who brought your contract, and I’d fired him already, but I couldn’t afford to pay the buyout... But that doesn’t change the fact that I sent a teenager into life-threatening situations knowing full well she was likely to fall sooner or later."
"Lady Tessa..." Elara whispered with a trembling voice. She became very emotional, not expecting her esteemed leader to feel so strongly about her.
"I would ask if you got the funds, but..." Tessa said wryly while replicating Kaiden’s hand actions as she began petting Elara’s head just as he was doing to Luna and Bastet.

"Yep," Kaiden grunted with a sly, smug smirk. "I have a faint inkling that our newest video will bring in quite a good amount of cash... We should have more than enough to fork out 100 Chronos and then some."

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Aria’s Plan
paragraphs: "Kaiden..." Not being able to hold back anymore, the teenage girl began sobbing tears of gratitude, which in turn made Tessa wince. ’Was being in my guild so bad...?’ But she already knew the answer. ’Of course it was. Not only did she put her life on the line, but she must’ve also been bullied... God damn it!’
"If you do that, I’ll repay my debt by saving you guys as many times as I can, no matter the injuries I have to sustain!"
To her surprise, Kaiden shook his head. "You won’t be doing any of that."
"W-what do you mean?"
"Nyx already told you that a girl your age should be in school. I wouldn’t feel right dragging you to dungeons with us. I want you to enroll in high school."
"What about her future expenses?" Luna asked.
"Can you tell us why you decided on your career path in the first place?" Aria asked in a friendly tone. All three ladies of Kaiden were in complete agreement with him on the matter.

Not knowing how to feel anymore, Elara gave up on reigning her emotions in. With muted sobs, she ventured to do as asked. "My little brother has cancer... The government helps with the basic treatment costs, but I want him to have the best care possible, and that means extra expenses we can’t afford on our own..."
"What an admirable big sis you are," Nyx purred with proudly gleaming eyes.
Suddenly, the girl regained the strength in her vocal cords as she fiercely stared into Kaiden’s eyes. "... But please, take me with you to the dungeons! I can’t accept your kindness like this!"

He was firm. "Out of the question." However, in the next moment, a gentle expression replaced his stern one. "But if you want to work to earn your keep, you could become our part-time employee. Though I don’t know what your job would be."
"She could take over my social media manager position, but..."
Luna was quick to agree. "Yeah, that’s not a job for children, considering she would have to see your hideously overgrown bazookas when making the thumbnails for some of our content."
A very mischievous grin appeared on the pink-haired beauty’s lips as she asked, "But it’s ok for her to see your hand grenades, bestie?"
"[Stormblad-]" Already knowing she would lunge at Nyx, Kaiden grabbed onto his Storm Valkyrie with both arms, restraining her. "Kai, stop holding me back! I’ll murder this dumb bitch."
"That’s exactly why I have to step between the two of you..." Kaiden replied wryly.

While the trio was busy with their little drama, Aria turned toward Elara with a warm smile. "How about becoming our housekeeper and combat gear organizer? Once we start collecting high-end equipment and luxurious artifacts as well as furniture, I’d rather not bring in some random cleaning lady who might get... curious. With your high Strength stat, you’ll have no trouble moving gear or furniture around, and with your experience as a dungeon aide, you already know how to handle sensitive equipment much better than any of us do. You could swing by every few days, whenever school schedule allows."

Elara blinked, clearly overwhelmed by how fast things were moving. Her lips parted once, then closed, then parted again as if she couldn’t quite find the right words. Finally, she managed to speak. Quietly at first, but with growing confidence.

"I... I think I’d really like that." Her voice trembled with emotion, but her eyes sparkled with something brighter than just tears: gratitude. "It sounds like something I’d be good at and would allow me to stay by my little brother’s side until the end, unlike working as a pack mule... And if it helps you all even a little, then I’d be proud to do it."

She wiped at her face quickly, embarrassed by the moisture on her cheeks. "Thank you. Really. I never thought... I mean, this is the first time I’ve been treated like more than just some disposable nobody."
Nyx leaned forward with a wink, masterfully dodging Luna’s claw swipe at her face. "You better get used to being spoiled, silly."
Elara smiled a small but genuine one as she nodded. "Then I’ll do my best. You won’t regret hiring me!"
Now that their business with Nova Circuit had concluded, and they had decided how to settle the debts owed, it was time for Valhalla’s Sinners to get a taste of how global stardom feels.
They got Elara’s contact information but left her with Tessa so that she could begin the process of officially withdrawing from Nova Circuit.
Afterward, Kaiden and the girls headed off to hail a taxi. However, when the vehicle arrived, an issue immediately presented itself: four seats, five people.
Kaiden blinked at the car, then turned to the others. "I’ll just grab another one. You all go ahead-"
"No need," Bastet purred confidently, stepping forward with a flick of her tail. "I’ll just sit in your-"

Before the Ra-Blessed Felinid could even finish, Luna shot forward with a strong huff, firmly shoving Kaiden into the front passenger seat. Then, without missing a beat, she plopped herself right into his lap.

"I’m the smallest one here," she explained, glancing back at Bastet with a smug smile adorning her delicate lips. "You’re not a little cat but a big woman with some cat-like traits, so stop acting like a house pet. I’ll sacrifice my comfort and sit here so that you fatties can get a seat each."
Kaiden didn’t argue. Instead, his hands instinctively found one of their favorite resting places: a delicious feminine belly.

Bastet hissed with great distaste for the Storm Valkyrie’s solution to the problem, and her expression twisted with territorial irritation, feeling as if she’d been challenged just now. She didn’t care about Luna or any of the others. All that mattered to her was him. Her one and only master.
Before she could make a scene, Nyx and Aria each grabbed one of her hands.
"Let’s not start hissing already," Nyx chuckled warmly, guiding her into the backseat.
Aria gave Bastet a pointed look. "You had your fun already. Be grateful you’re even in the car and not dead in your sandy pyramid."
Grumbling but ultimately relenting after Kaiden sent her a stern glance, Bastet folded her arms as she was sandwiched between the two Valkyries.
By the time they returned to their apartment, the tension from the car ride had mostly faded. Spirits were high.
"We should have a big celebratory meal just like we did it at the sushi place after the filming!" Nyx chirped in excitement. "We cleared our first major dungeon together and even tamed a monster!"
"I’m not a monster..." Bastet growled but was ignored.
"I’m down," Kaiden said. "I wanted to try that rare Japanese beef, Wagyu something? And-"
But just as they approached their rented apartment door, he stopped mid-step.
Someone was standing in front of it.

But just as they approached their rented apartment door, he stopped mid-step.
Someone was standing in front of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: But?
paragraphs: A woman, clad in a sharp black suit and matching glasses, stood with perfect posture. Her jet-black hair was tied into a tidy bun. Flanking her were two tall, broad-shouldered men in tactical vests, each with communication earpieces in their ears and unreadable expressions on their faces.
Kaiden’s body tensed, and his eyes narrowed. He knew it was a possibility, but...
’Already? Damn it! How did they find our location so soon?’
The woman didn’t replicate his hostile stance. Instead, she lifted both hands slowly and calmly as her lips parted into a polite, professional smile.
"Please don’t be alarmed," she said in a smooth, practiced voice. "My name is Grace. I serve as the executive secretary to the Chairman of the Awakened Association."
Kaiden didn’t relax. Neither did the others, who had already grabbed their weapons from their bags while Bastet’s pupils thinned as she scanned the intruders.

Grace’s gaze briefly drifted to the feline, and for a moment, she froze with her eyes widening in unfiltered awe. Her breath caught in her throat as her pupils trembled with wonderment. She couldn’t believe what her eyes were showing her.
But she quickly composed herself, coughing lightly into her palm. "Ahem. Pardon me. It’s... not every day you see such a sight."
Bastet merely tilted her head to the side, not impressed by the praise she was receiving. "What do you want, human?"
Grace smiled again, though slightly tighter now. She turned back to Kaiden.

"We believe you, Kaiden Grey, your companion Bastet, and the young women accompanying you, namely: Luna Aster, Aria Levander, and Nyx Cosmos may be facing imminent danger. Not from dungeons or monsters, but from rogue organizations, foreign governments, and private parties eager to study—or claim—you all."
Kaiden’s frown deepened, but the wild pounding of his heart lessened. ’So that’s what this is about... They’re quick to act, that’s for certain.’

"You’re all too unique," Grace continued her explanation. "An awakened male who successfully tamed a monster. Three women who awakened in the same time frames, at the same location, and are acquaintances. If that wasn’t enough, all three of you have the previously unseen Valkyrie subclass category and were shown to have the exact same power output during your evaluation as Kaiden with his Paragon of Sin class. The five of you have become a beacon... and a target."

She gestured to the two imposing men standing beside her. "These are Agents Hugh and Oren. Both are A-tier awakened, trained for close protection, extraction under duress, and rapid magical response. The Chairman wishes to offer their services to you."

The one on the left, Agent Hugh, gave a slight nod, face like stone. His visible aura radiated the same pressure Kaiden remembered feeling from his mother—though to a much lesser degree. It marked Agent Hugh as a high-level awakened. The other, Agent Oren, looked a touch more relaxed but was equally formidable. The kind of guy who wouldn’t flinch if a dragon landed on the roof.

Grace continued. "The Chairman has personally ordered that you be given a temporary secure residence. One shielded with high-grade stealth enchantments and spatial interference barriers. It’s off-grid and not something easily traced or broken into, unlike this rental apartment."
"So you’re saying this is all for our safety...?" Luna asked suspiciously.

Grace nodded. "The Chairman believes in acting before tragedy strikes, not after. But the choice is yours. We won’t force you. However, we would highly advise against staying in this location any longer. If you do choose to remain, we’ll be forced to evacuate the other residents for their protection, as... hostile encounters are a near certain guarantee."
Kaiden had to do his utmost to not have his lips curl into a giant, victorious grin.
This development was exactly what he was hoping for.

The government was ready to secure his safety while he and his girls were still weak, letting them traverse the road to stardom with more peace of mind. The services of bodyguards with the level of these two men were incredibly hard to come by. Valhalla’s Sinners certainly couldn’t finance their protection out of their own pockets.
The secure location was a giant added bonus he didn’t even expect. Grace was right—this apartment was nice to live in, but its defenses against awakened attacks were nonexistent.

Kaiden was very well aware that the association wasn’t doing this out of the kindness of their hearts: with this arrangement, they had the perfect chance to spy on him and his girls, allowing them to try learning their secrets through this peaceful method. He didn’t want to have government agents sniffing around his home, but it was definitely a trade he was willing to make until they became strong enough to give them the boot.
There was just one issue.
"Miss Grace, I truly appreciate your thoughtful actions and I’m leaning toward accepting your generous offer. But..."
"But?" Grace asked with a raised eyebrow, clearly expecting him to jump on the hand they extended toward him.
"I must ask, do you happen to have female agents instead?"
"... What?" The executive secretary couldn’t help but gasp. The two agents also raised a surprised eyebrow in his direction.

Meanwhile, his three Valkyries eyed their man with a deadpan expression. They couldn’t believe he was being serious right now. However, after a mere moment of observation, they each realized it in perfect sync and cried inwardly together, ’He’s totally serious!’

Kaiden ventured to explain himself. "You must know the kind of career path we decided to follow, correct? We’re not just awakened combatants but entertainers. I wouldn’t be able to enjoy my time with my ladies if I knew a pair of men were listening to their sexy moans outside my bedroom door." Kaiden then grimaced strongly as if he’d just smelled the stink of rotten fish before saying, "Truth be told, it would be a complete turnoff."
Grace blinked once. Then again.
A long pause followed in their conversation.

Agent Hugh and Agent Oren exchanged a single glance. Neither of them looked offended, but their perfectly stoic professionalism cracked just slightly, enough for a flicker of ’...Did he just say that?’ to slip through their eyes.

Grace, to her credit, didn’t immediately object or scoff. Her years in high-level diplomacy and executive operations kept her composed, but it was clear this wasn’t a request she received often. Or ever.

"I... see," she said while carefully adjusting her glasses. "That is certainly... a unique consideration." Grace studied him for a few seconds longer, clearly recalculating her approach. She had handled all sorts of eccentric requests from celebrities, diplomats, and worst of all, the chairman himself, but this one still made her blink twice.
"Mr. Kaiden," she began slowly, "we are trained to handle requests with privacy, and I assure you these men are bound by strict nondisclosure and personal integrity-"

"I don’t doubt their professionalism," Kaiden cut in, waving a hand dismissively. "But this isn’t about trust. It’s about mood. Atmosphere. Vibe." He motioned at his girls, all of whom wore slightly pinched expressions caught between embarrassment and acceptance. "What kind of a man wants to be passionately expressing himself to his partners while two guys are listening in?" He finished while glancing at the two men, who offered no response.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: New Home
paragraphs: Grace opened her mouth, then paused. To her own horror, her brain actually conjured the mental image and she couldn’t help but understand where he was coming from. If she were a man, she wouldn’t want it either.

’I truly am speaking with Vespera’s son... Only they have the gall to say such insane lines in front of high-ranking officials... Though I can’t help but notice that her son is much more of a lustful person... or perhaps a romantic? Vespera doesn’t seem to care about fleeting things such as love...’

"...Understood," she finally said. "We may have alternative agents more suited to... this particular arrangement. I’ll send them to your new home. Until then, please make do with Agent Hugh and Oren."
"Appreciate it and will do," Kaiden replied with a relaxed nod as if they’d just agreed on what pizza toppings to order.
Nyx, Aria, and Luna sighed in synchronized disbelief.

Bastet, on the other hand, purred with great pride while staring at Kaiden. The Ra-Blessed Felinid had felt how strong these three people were, and she knew perfectly well they would get murdered should conflict occur. Despite this, her master spoke to them as if they were his lowly servants. Just how amazing was he?!

The journey to their new home didn’t take long, though the transport used was anything but ordinary. Grace had arranged for a mana-shrouded vehicle. It was smooth, silent, and virtually undetectable. No license plates, no visible branding, no emissions. It had a faint spatial distortion around it, blending subtly into the road like a ripple in reality.

Kaiden sat near the back with his girls beside him, arms casually draped behind Nyx and Aria. Luna sat across from them, and she was busy fiddling with the security terminal’s interface, trying to crack how it jammed all incoming signals while keeping navigation online.

All these high-tier tech and artifacts made the gamer girl in her come out, letting the Moon and Space Valkyries enjoy their Paragon of Sin’s company without having to listen to her huffs and puffs. Bastet, for her part, lounged like royalty across their laps. The tanned feline greatly enjoyed their current seating accommodations.
"Where exactly are we headed?" Kaiden asked, glancing at Grace, who’d opted to ride with them.

"A mountainside location just outside the city limits. It used to be an observation outpost back during the first dungeon outbreaks. We’ve since reinforced it and converted the interior into a living space fit for long-term habitation. Completely cut off from scrying and unauthorized communication."

The vehicle dipped into a concealed tunnel. Walls of rune-carved stone zipped past them as they went deeper beneath the forested outskirts. Eventually, the tunnel opened up, revealing a steel-bastioned entryway built directly into a cliff face. Automated turrets and sensor drones greeted them with scanning rays before the entrance slid open.
Inside, they stepped into what looked like a hidden military facility.

Concrete floors. Reinforced steel doors. The air was cool and clean, with just a hint of mana-processed filtration. The ceilings were high, and the layout was wide enough to accommodate both domestic living and tactical defense.

"It’s not much to look at," Grace admitted, "but it’s sturdy. Most awakened with ill intent wouldn’t be able to find it, and those who do won’t be able to breach it, especially not without alerting our network."
Kaiden’s girls spread out, exploring the space. The layout reminded them more of a high-tech bunker than a luxurious home or a military outpost, but it was equipped with everything they needed:
Four private bedrooms with reinforced mana-blocking walls.
Next, a central living area with modern amenities, shielded from surveillance spells and enchanted with anti-eavesdropping fields.
There were also two bathrooms with reinforced mana-shield generators.
A utilitarian but properly equipped training chamber sealed tight with shock-absorbing enchantments occupied the basement.
Lastly, a small comm room that allowed filtered outbound communication, but only through verified encrypted lines.
Luna tapped on the wall with a raised brow. "This is some sort of reinforced alloy..."
Aria peeked into the armory corner. "Empty shelves, but... there’s room for customization. Guess we’ll be filling this ourselves."
Nyx silently ran her fingers along the edges of the rune-sealed windows, coyly noting how the outer camouflage would conceal both light and sound even if all girls moaned at full volume.
Kaiden whistled. "Honestly, it’s way better than I expected. This is not at all a five-star luxury resort but a top-notch defensive residence. Exactly what Valhalla’s Sinners need right now."

Grace gave a small nod. "I agree. Your careers may be unconventional, and I’m sure you were mocked or at least were treated condescendingly up until now, and that may continue in the future. But make no mistake: many eyes are watching you now. The eyes of both the common folk and the powerful. That comes with danger, but also opportunity. I sincerely hope you’ll make the most of it."
"Thank you, Miss Grace," Aria chirped, appreciating the woman’s honest words.
"You’re welcome." The secretary smiled, but then her phone began ringing.
*Ring!* *Ring!*

"Ah, it must be them," she murmured while picking up a special artifact set to the designated communication channel that worked even inside this place. "You’re here already? You two sure work fast... All right, I’ll let you in."

She put the phone down and glanced at the squad of curious youngsters. "Your new bodyguards are here. I recommend you treat them with respect. They’re very strong but also rather young and less... stone-faced. Agent Hugh and Oren were already trained government agents before the Mana Apocalypse hit; these ladies were in middle school back then."

Kaiden couldn’t help but gulp, having an ominous feeling about this statement of the secretary woman. Well, he did ask for this, so he was getting what he reaped, the Paragon of Sin supposed. He glanced at his Valkyries, who returned his look with expressions ranging from curiosity to thinly veiled amusement.
With great curiosity, they walked to the front door to welcome the newcomers in.
