chapters.title: Chapter 165: New Bodyguards
paragraphs: Author: Pics on discord
With great curiosity, they walked to the front door to welcome the newcomers in.
The door swung open with a loud creak, but the voice that burst through was even louder.
"Hey, hey, hey! Is this where the famous harem I gotta protect with my life resides?!"

The question hit like a thunderclap, echoing through the hall and instantly killing any and all formality. The girl who shouted it strolled in with a swagger that matched her volume, each step practically radiating chaotic energy.

She was a vision of bold contrast: sun-kissed bronze skin gleaming under the warm indoor lighting, toned muscles on full display under a white, sleeveless, high-necked top that looked just fancy enough to be inappropriate for combat. Yet somehow, it worked. The intricate lace patterns at her chest were as distracting as they were elegant, while her chiseled abs stood as strong hints at the sheer physicality behind that flamboyant attitude of hers.

Her snow-white hair, cut in a short bob at shoulder-length with uneven bangs, framed a devilish grin and a pair of golden eyes that glittered with mischief. She was gorgeous in a way that could stop traffic, but carried herself with all the restraint of a grenade rolling down a church aisle.
She popped a hip and scanned the room with a cocky tilt of her head, until her gaze landed squarely on Kaiden.
She didn’t just look at him. She drank him in.
"Well, well, well," she said, lips stretching into a sharp grin. "You’ve gotta be the guy, huh? The one every horny chick is raving about online... The harem king with a flair for exhibitionism..."
Kaiden flashed her a confident grin, matching her energy with surprising ease. "I might just be that guy," he replied, stepping forward and extending a hand.

Without missing a beat, Rae slapped her palm into his with a loud smack, their fingers locking tight in a firm, solid handshake that felt more like the start of a dare than a greeting. Neither of them blinked, neither of them backed off. It was respect at first squeeze.
The three Valkyries stood off to the side, arms crossed before their chests or hanging limp by their sides, all of them watching the unfolding scene with dry expressions.
"...He likes her a lot," Nyx muttered, squinting.
"Of course he does..." Aria sighed. "This gal seems at least as chaotic as Miss Chaos Gremlin herself..."
"Imma be ignoring that one for your sake, Princess..." Luna hissed before adding her findings with an amused expression. "It feels like he found a best buddy. They clicked instantly."
They weren’t wrong. The way Kaiden’s eyes lit up told them everything: they all recognized the spark of a man who’d just met someone with the same brand of chaos in their bloodstream.
Rae grinned widely, never letting go of his hand. "Name’s Rae. I pride myself on being the chaos of the battlefield. Point me at something, and I’ll make it stop existing."
Kaiden’s grin widened. "Can’t wait to see you in action."

At that, Rae finally let go of his hand, stepping back with a cackling laugh. "Oh, you won’t have to wait long, boss man. Keep making headlines like this, and I’ll be busy saving your ass every other hour."
She then jabbed a thumb at his chest. "Scratch that... The one headline you’ve already made has blown half the world’s mind. You already have numerous enemies."
Kaiden laughed wryly at that, rubbing the back of his neck. "Then I guess we’ll be in your hands for a while... at least until we can catch up and protect ourselves properly."
After he said those words, his curiosity shifted.
Kaiden peeked easily over Rae’s head, given that the bronze-skinned firecracker didn’t even graze his shoulder, even if she tiptoed. The moment his gaze shifted, Rae’s ever-confident grin twitched.
"Rude..." she muttered with a roll of her eyes. "You just gonna look over a girl’s head like I’m not even here, huh?"
Kaiden smirked but didn’t answer.
Rae clicked her tongue and turned halfway, glancing around. "Riven’s not the type to hide shyly from people. If she’s not here, she probably-"

"Got distracted, didn’t she?" Kaiden finished, already walking. He knew perfectly well how curious this location was, and based on Grace’s words, these two should be very strong bodyguards who lack lacking in professional attitude. Getting distracted by a high-tier artifact was exactly something a new guard might do.
With a collective shrug, the group stepped out through the wide doorway of the high-tech bunker, boots clinking against the plated steel before they hit the gravel path outside.
And sure enough...

A few feet away stood a girl hauling a backpack so comically oversized that it made standard dungeon aides look like they were on a field trip. Towering above her like a mechanical tortoise shell, the pack was lined with reinforced casing, clamps, folded limbs, mechanical arms, and god-knows-what-else.
But she wasn’t done: dragging behind her were two floating platforms stacked with parts, half-assembled contraptions, glowing cores, and what might’ve been a coffee maker wired into a plasma cutter.
The woman herself stood in front of a small, inactive turret dome embedded into the outer wall of the bunker, her attention locked onto the device like it had whispered secrets to her.
She looked like a rogue scientist caught red-handed, wrenches in hand, mid-tinker.

Her glasses had slipped slightly down the bridge of her nose, shadowing a pair of sharp, intelligent eyes surrounded by dark circles that made it painfully clear: this was a woman who hadn’t slept properly in days, possibly weeks. The only thing keeping her vertical was a cocktail of absurdly high Vitality stats and so much caffeine it probably counted as a blood type.

Her appearance was just as eccentric as the rest of the woman, as she wore nothing above the waist but a white lab coat that was unbuttoned and lazily thrown on over a matching set of black lace underwear that clung snugly to her plush, full figure.

sentences.text: Author: Pics on discord
With great curiosity, they walked to the front door to welcome the newcomers in.
The door swung open with a loud creak, but the voice that burst through was even louder.
"Hey, hey, hey!
Is this where the famous harem I gotta protect with my life resides?!"
The question hit like a thunderclap, echoing through the hall and instantly killing any and all formality.
The girl who shouted it strolled in with a swagger that matched her volume, each step practically radiating chaotic energy.

She was a vision of bold contrast: sun-kissed bronze skin gleaming under the warm indoor lighting, toned muscles on full display under a white, sleeveless, high-necked top that looked just fancy enough to be inappropriate for combat.
Yet somehow, it worked.
The intricate lace patterns at her chest were as distracting as they were elegant, while her chiseled abs stood as strong hints at the sheer physicality behind that flamboyant attitude of hers.
Her snow-white hair, cut in a short bob at shoulder-length with uneven bangs, framed a devilish grin and a pair of golden eyes that glittered with mischief.
She was gorgeous in a way that could stop traffic, but carried herself with all the restraint of a grenade rolling down a church aisle.
She popped a hip and scanned the room with a cocky tilt of her head, until her gaze landed squarely on Kaiden.
She didn’t just look at him.
She drank him in.
"Well, well, well," she said, lips stretching into a sharp grin.
"You’ve gotta be the guy, huh?
The one every horny chick is raving about online...
The harem king with a flair for exhibitionism..."
Kaiden flashed her a confident grin, matching her energy with surprising ease.
"I might just be that guy," he replied, stepping forward and extending a hand.
Without missing a beat, Rae slapped her palm into his with a loud smack, their fingers locking tight in a firm, solid handshake that felt more like the start of a dare than a greeting.
Neither of them blinked, neither of them backed off.
It was respect at first squeeze.
The three Valkyries stood off to the side, arms crossed before their chests or hanging limp by their sides, all of them watching the unfolding scene with dry expressions.
"...He likes her a lot," Nyx muttered, squinting.
"Of course he does..." Aria sighed.
"This gal seems at least as chaotic as Miss Chaos Gremlin herself..."
"Imma be ignoring that one for your sake, Princess..." Luna hissed before adding her findings with an amused expression.
"It feels like he found a best buddy.
They clicked instantly."
They weren’t wrong.
The way Kaiden’s eyes lit up told them everything: they all recognized the spark of a man who’d just met someone with the same brand of chaos in their bloodstream.
Rae grinned widely, never letting go of his hand.
"Name’s Rae.
I pride myself on being the chaos of the battlefield.
Point me at something, and I’ll make it stop existing."
Kaiden’s grin widened.
"Can’t wait to see you in action."
At that, Rae finally let go of his hand, stepping back with a cackling laugh.
"Oh, you won’t have to wait long, boss man.
Keep making headlines like this, and I’ll be busy saving your ass every other hour."
She then jabbed a thumb at his chest.
"Scratch that...
The one headline you’ve already made has blown half the world’s mind.
You already have numerous enemies."
Kaiden laughed wryly at that, rubbing the back of his neck.
"Then I guess we’ll be in your hands for a while... at least until we can catch up and protect ourselves properly."
After he said those words, his curiosity shifted.
Kaiden peeked easily over Rae’s head, given that the bronze-skinned firecracker didn’t even graze his shoulder, even if she tiptoed.
The moment his gaze shifted, Rae’s ever-confident grin twitched.
"Rude..." she muttered with a roll of her eyes.
"You just gonna look over a girl’s head like I’m not even here, huh?"
Kaiden smirked but didn’t answer.
Rae clicked her tongue and turned halfway, glancing around.
"Riven’s not the type to hide shyly from people.
If she’s not here, she probably-"
"Got distracted, didn’t she?" Kaiden finished, already walking.
He knew perfectly well how curious this location was, and based on Grace’s words, these two should be very strong bodyguards who lack lacking in professional attitude.
Getting distracted by a high-tier artifact was exactly something a new guard might do.
With a collective shrug, the group stepped out through the wide doorway of the high-tech bunker, boots clinking against the plated steel before they hit the gravel path outside.
And sure enough...
A few feet away stood a girl hauling a backpack so comically oversized that it made standard dungeon aides look like they were on a field trip.
Towering above her like a mechanical tortoise shell, the pack was lined with reinforced casing, clamps, folded limbs, mechanical arms, and god-knows-what-else.
But she wasn’t done: dragging behind her were two floating platforms stacked with parts, half-assembled contraptions, glowing cores, and what might’ve been a coffee maker wired into a plasma cutter.
The woman herself stood in front of a small, inactive turret dome embedded into the outer wall of the bunker, her attention locked onto the device like it had whispered secrets to her.
She looked like a rogue scientist caught red-handed, wrenches in hand, mid-tinker.

Her glasses had slipped slightly down the bridge of her nose, shadowing a pair of sharp, intelligent eyes surrounded by dark circles that made it painfully clear: this was a woman who hadn’t slept properly in days, possibly weeks.
The only thing keeping her vertical was a cocktail of absurdly high Vitality stats and so much caffeine it probably counted as a blood type.

Her appearance was just as eccentric as the rest of the woman, as she wore nothing above the waist but a white lab coat that was unbuttoned and lazily thrown on over a matching set of black lace underwear that clung snugly to her plush, full figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Riven and Rae
paragraphs: Her voluptuous chest strained against the fabric with every breath, while her soft, round belly peeked through beneath the coat, unapologetically on display.

Despite looking like she’d crawled out of a lab explosion and straight into a lingerie ad, she moved with purpose, clearly aware of just exactly what she was doing. Her wrenches danced from bolt to hinge with delicate precision, and her eyes glinted with obsessive focus as she studied the deactivated turret.
She was in her element, cheeks flushed, lips parted, and tongue extended in concentration. She looked like a woman falling in love with a circuit board.
"Riven Forjex!" came a sharp voice, slicing through the air like a bureaucratic sword.
The girl froze.

Grace, the chairman’s ever-professional secretary, stormed out from behind the group, heels clicking sharply on the solid pavement. "You are strictly forbidden from dismantling any of the defensive hardware present in this location, got it?!"
Riven turned slowly, like a child caught with her hand in the honey jar. She blinked at Grace.
Then, she pouted.

It wasn’t small, either: her entire expression collapsed into a sulk so powerful it might’ve collapsed a lesser soul. She huffed loudly, but her wrench-laden arms dropped to her sides in defeat. Her eyes met Grace’s, looking at her as if the woman had just kicked a puppy.
Then, with all the dramatic flair of a heavily disappointed mad scientist, Riven scoffed. Hard.

It was the kind of scoff that carried the weight of crushed dreams, delayed projects, and at least three denied funding proposals. Her head tilted just enough for her long, dark bangs to veil her eyes, and her glossy lips parted with practiced disgust, as if Grace had just personally banned innovation itself.
Kaiden blinked in surprise. His eyebrows crept up as he murmured, "What a strange woman."
That declaration of his earned him three synchronized deadpans from his Valkyries once again.

They each had the same thought: ’Says the dude who instantly vibed with the chaotic chick with a 6-pack abs and tanned skin who called him an exhibitionist harem king... Rae is a perfectly normal woman, right, Kai?’

Kaiden scratched his cheek when he felt three pairs of eyes pointedly staring at his back, wondering if he had done something weird, then flinched when Rae elbowed him for a bit too much strength for his current low-level body to withstand without a reaction.

"Meet Riven," Rae said, proud and greatly amused. "I’m pretty sure she’s autistic as fuck, though the doctors say she’s just a ’true eccentric.’ Whatever that means. Either way, she’s a real piece of work. Be that as it may, I love her a lot. She’s the best, a real fun girl to be around. And she’s also very strong. I wouldn’t want anyone else to have my back but her."

That last part made Kaiden’s eyes light up with genuine curiosity, a sharp glint flickering through them. His stance shifted forward instinctively, like a man sniffing out potential in the most unconventional package.
"Oh?" he asked, clearly intrigued. "Now I really want to see what you two can do."
Meanwhile, a short distance away, Bastet had remained mostly silent, watching the slow-burn stare-down between Grace and Riven unfold with her usual feline aloofness.
She narrowed her golden eyes and murmured under her breath, "Humans are very weird creatures... Though..." Her tail flicked as her gaze drifted to Kaiden.

"My master is obviously exceptional. So... not all humans are entirely useless. Maybe it’s just the females. Their intellect seems disproportionately erratic, lacking in comparison to their male counterparts. Perhaps they are solely suited for breeding purposes."
Nyx, having overheard that, snorted dryly. "Thanks, feline bestie. I love you, too."
Bastet didn’t even look her way. She simply shrugged, shoulders languid and posture unbothered, like she had just passed along a universal truth and couldn’t be bothered with emotional baggage.
The Ra-Blessed Felinid wasn’t built for etiquette. It’s not that she couldn’t act like a proper high-class lady if she wanted to, no.

The problem with her attitude stemmed from the fact that she only cared about what Kaiden thought regarding her actions and statements. Whether Nyx and the rest got annoyed didn’t matter in her mind one bit.

Grace and Riven continued their silent staredown, the air between them thick with suppressed sighs and unspoken threats of confiscated tools. The secretary’s gaze was sharp enough to cut glass, and Riven—despite her clear exhaustion and caffeine-fueled constitution—managed to keep eye contact with all the stubbornness of a gremlin guarding her last energy drink.
Finally, Grace adjusted her glasses with a sharp motion and straightened her spine with military precision. With a crisp snap of her fingers, she turned to gesture toward the rear of the group.

From behind the gathering, two men approached, moving with the stoic gait of professionals who’d seen far too much and complained far too little. Both wore matte black security suits fitted with light armor plating and scanning visors on standby.
Agents Hugh and Oren.
Their strides were calm and measured. Both gave Kaiden respectful nods as they stopped at Grace’s side.

"It’s time for us to say goodbye for now," Grace announced coolly, voice poised and professional despite the chaos that had unfolded around her since the arrival of the new bodyguard pair. "I’ll be reachable at any any time of the day from the communications room inside the bunker. Should any issues arise—technical, logistical, or behavioral—you are to notify me immediately."
Her eyes slid back toward Riven, sharp as a scalpel.

"And you... Nothing in the bunker is for you to take apart. If you’re curious about a system, component, relic, or even a doorframe, you are to submit an official request and await approval before so much as breathing on it."
Riven let out the tiniest whimper of a sigh, her shoulders slumping with the reluctant acceptance of a child told they can’t lick the battery. She hugged her oversized wrench like a plushie.
"...Yes, ma’am," she muttered with great difficulty, finally accepting defeat. For now.
Grace’s gaze shifted with robotic precision to Rae, her expression not softening an inch. In fact, it only hardened.

"And you. Any destruction of state property, civilian assets, bunker infrastructure, or the possessions of Valhalla’s Sinners will be coming out of your pay. You’re already greatly indebted to the state, Rae. I recommend you stay on your best behavior."
Rae threw up a casual salute, all grins and teeth, clearly not bothered much about the issues with her monetary compensation.
"Aye-aye, Ma’am. Now, about my previous requisition request?"
She leaned in. "Y’know, the 80-inch OLED TV, high-end gaming console, and... I believe it was a thousand bags of chips and liters of coke? Every month?"
Grace closed her eyes for a beat, visibly drawing upon the strength of every late-night coffee she’d ever drunk in her life.
"We’re... working on it."
"Much appreciated, boss lady."

Grace sighed and finally turned to Kaiden. Her face softened dramatically, as if she was now talking to her best friend, while before, she was forced to speak to a pair of lecherous perverts who kept harassing her on company time.
"You asked for this. Good luck, Mr. Kaiden, Ladies."

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Introductions
paragraphs: With that, she gave the group a final nod and pivoted sharply on her heel. Her elegant black suit’s coat fluttered behind her as she strode off toward her ride. Agents Hugh and Oren followed in silence.
And just like that, the old guard exited.
Leaving Kaiden with his newly acquired chaos duo of mad creator and frenetic destroyer.
As Nyx watched Grace’s rapidly departing form, she couldn’t help but murmur under her breath, "Well... If there’s one thing we can say for certain, is that our home life won’t be boring."

"It wouldn’t have been boring even if it were the male bodyguards with us! We just acquired a freaking sand feline, and the four of us never got bored in each other’s company before!" Luna scoffed, sending Kaiden a glare for having invited this pair of oddballs into their home.
"Let’s give them a chance! They seem like nice girls," Aria whispered, more hopeful than confident.

Bastet, as always, simply yawned—unbothered, unfazed, and unconcerned by the mounting tension between the old team and the freshly added wildcards. She sprawled across the nearest sun-warmed crate like a lounging queen, tail swishing idly.

Kaiden stood at the center of it all, watching Rae excitedly jab Riven in the ribs while the latter muttered about circuit insulation and adaptive plating materials. Behind him, his Valkyries exchanged varied looks of disbelief, doubt, and something dangerously close to resignation.
And yet, for all the chaos and conflicting energy, he couldn’t help but grin.
This... This was the start of something new. Maybe a little volatile. Maybe a lot insane.
But it was gonna be a banger, he could tell.

As the group slowly started toward the bunker’s main entrance, Kaiden’s eyes lingered on the horizon. He knew that the stakes had risen incredibly high from one moment to the next. His decision to subjugate Bastet on stream was gonna have many pros, but a great deal of cons as well...
The world had watched them.
They had seen him.
Be that as it may, it’s already been done. His name was spreading like wildfire right this moment, and now that they had returned triumphantly, there was one thing left to do.
Celebrate.

"Alright, team," Kaiden called out, drawing everyone’s attention as the metal doors of the bunker hissed open behind them. "We’ve got a party to throw. Desert dungeon victory. New teammates. And... let’s just say, I’ve got a plan."
Rae perked up instantly. "A plan plan? Or a ’content creator’ plan?"
Kaiden winked. "Both."
Luna rolled her eyes. "Oh no."
Nyx grinned. "Oh yes."
Aria blinked with concern, creasing her brow. "Is it dangerous, Kai? Maybe we should lay low for a bit..."
Kaiden stepped backward into the bunker’s shadowy threshold, his silhouette framed by the sunlight behind him.
"Lying low sounds smart, my beloved Aria, you’re perfectly right," he said while flashing a grin. "But you know what they say... strike the iron while it’s hot."
He raised a hand dramatically as his grin deepened. "So, my gorgeous Valkyries..."
"It’s time we..."

The group moved inside, the heavy metal doors hissing shut behind them, sealing them away from the harsh outside world. The bunker’s interior was spacious and cool to the skin, though not at all cold enough to be a bother, especially to people who invested a few extra points into their Vitality stat.
Kaiden made his way to a plush sofa, sinking into its depths with a contented sigh.
Aria, ever the needy soul, immediately settled onto his left thigh, while Luna, with a similarly needy wiggle of her delicate butt, claimed his right.
Bastet, true to form, had already fallen asleep outside the bunker entrance in a stretched-out, lazy pose, a picture of feline tranquility.

Nyx, humming a cheerful tune, positioned herself behind Kaiden, and her skilled, submissive hands began a shoulder massage that melted away any lingering tension in her man’s frame. Life, for Nyx, seemed to be a continuous series of delightful surprises these days. A happy little massage was the least she could give Kaiden for having changed her life so drastically, the Space Valkyrie thought.

Across from them, on an identical sofa, sat Riven, her attention consumed by the glowing screen of a tablet she held. She occasionally adjusted her glasses, becoming the perfect picture of focused intensity, clearly immersed in whatever intricate data or schematics filled her display.

On the armrest next to her, Rae lounged with an easy confidence with her bright eyes scanning the new faces before her. She wasn’t shy about her scrutiny one bit, openly studying Kaiden, Aria, Luna, and Nyx with a nonchalant yet curious expression, as if assessing their various attributes and quirks. Her gaze lingered on each of them in turn, her confident demeanor betraying no concern that they were all perfectly aware of her blatant staring. She seemed to be a woman who gathered information as she pleased, without apology.

Rae’s voice, sharp and to the point as ever, cut through the comfortable silence. "You do know we’re not your buddies but your bodyguards, right? There’s no need to sit us down for a chat... In fact, I believe it’s quite unprofessional... not that I care, of course." She finished with a dismissive shrug.

Kaiden simply smiled in return, his fingers finding their way toward two amazing destinations, where he began stroking Luna’s and Aria’s thighs to make himself feel even more at home. "I’m perfectly aware that it’s unprofessional," he replied as his gaze met Rae’s.

"But my hope is that while you remain our bodyguards, we can eliminate the usual stiffness that comes with the job... We’re not your usual clients, truth be told, and based on my initial impression of you two, I’d say that neither are you ladies the old-school stone-faced bodyguard types... Anyhow, all I wanted to say is that if you’re going to be present in my home all the time, I’d like to be able to relax with my girls in earnest. I don’t want to walk on eggshells to remain professional with our guards."
A wide, approving grin spread across Rae’s face. "Already loving my first client," she declared. "My training didn’t prepare me for this, but I’m down."
Then, without another word, she slapped Riven on the back of the head with a force that sent both her glasses and tablet tumbling to the floor.

Her gaze lingered on each of them in turn, her confident demeanor betraying no concern that they were all perfectly aware of her blatant staring.
She seemed to be a woman who gathered information as she pleased, without apology.
Rae’s voice, sharp and to the point as ever, cut through the comfortable silence.
"You do know we’re not your buddies but your bodyguards, right?
There’s no need to sit us down for a chat...
In fact, I believe it’s quite unprofessional... not that I care, of course." She finished with a dismissive shrug.
Kaiden simply smiled in return, his fingers finding their way toward two amazing destinations, where he began stroking Luna’s and Aria’s thighs to make himself feel even more at home.
"I’m perfectly aware that it’s unprofessional," he replied as his gaze met Rae’s.
"But my hope is that while you remain our bodyguards, we can eliminate the usual stiffness that comes with the job...
We’re not your usual clients, truth be told, and based on my initial impression of you two, I’d say that neither are you ladies the old-school stone-faced bodyguard types...
Anyhow, all I wanted to say is that if you’re going to be present in my home all the time, I’d like to be able to relax with my girls in earnest.
I don’t want to walk on eggshells to remain professional with our guards."
A wide, approving grin spread across Rae’s face.
"Already loving my first client," she declared.
"My training didn’t prepare me for this, but I’m down."
Then, without another word, she slapped Riven on the back of the head with a force that sent both her glasses and tablet tumbling to the floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Getting Along
paragraphs: Riven nearly followed her items to the ground, catching herself just in time before sending a furious glare at Rae. Rae merely laughed, patting Riven’s lush black hair. "You’re being overly rude to our new awesome buddies," she chided playfully.
At that, Riven seemed to snap out of her focused trance. A blush crept up her neck and onto her cheeks as she realized the truth of Rae’s words. She quickly stammered out an apology.

"I’m so sorry..." she mumbled, bending down to retrieve her fallen glasses and tablet. "I... I was just trying to figure out what sort of inner mechanism the Association was hiding in that outer turret of theirs."
Nyx and Aria spoke up at once, voices overlapping with bright curiosity.
"Wait, wait! Did you find something?"
"We’ve been wondering about the bunker’s weird defenses, too!"

Despite Riven’s eccentric aura, or rather because of it, all three Valkyries found themselves oddly drawn to her. Maybe it was the dead-serious expression she wore beneath the comically oversized lab coat that barely concealed her extremely generous feminine figure, or maybe it was the vibe of a genius too consumed by curiosity to remember she was dressed like a girl who’d lost a bet. Either way... despite the very weird first impressions, they kinda liked her.
Riven pushed her glasses up the bridge of her nose and scoffed.

"Those bastards knew exactly what they were doing. There are too many safeguards wrapped around the sensitive hardware. I couldn’t break through more than surface-level diagnostics." She grumbled, then tapped a finger against her temple. "But I did learn one thing about those outer wall-mounted sentry arrays... they’re self-activating proximity-based mana-reactive laser turrets."
There was a beat of silence.
Nyx’s fingers tightened suddenly on Kaiden’s shoulder, her expression paling.
Aria clutched at Kaiden’s hand that was still stroking her juicy thighs, with a soft gasp escaping her delicate lips, eyes wide with shock. "Laser... turrets...?"
"Proximity-based?" Luna echoed, her gamer-girl instincts screaming ’danger.’

Riven noticed their worried expressions and waved her hand dismissively in response. "You don’t have to worry. They only fire on hostiles. If your mana signature’s been registered with the bunker’s internal system, you’re fine. You could walk naked out there and the thing wouldn’t so much as track you."
A synchronized sigh of relief came from the trio.
"That’s... good to know," Aria mumbled under her breath with a bit of color returning to her cheeks.
"Very good," Nyx echoed, letting go of Kaiden’s shoulder with a pat before she resumed his gentle but firm massaging.

Meanwhile, Luna leaned forward eagerly, eyes sparkling. "That’s so cool...! Like, terrifying, but cool. High-tech hidden weapons in our home? This place is like an endgame loot room with its many defenses..."

Riven’s entire demeanor lit up at the enthusiasm the Chaos Gremlin showcased. Her eyes sparkled behind her lenses. "Right?! High tech everywhere I look! And that damned cunt- ehem, I mean, Lady Grace, forbade me from studying them at length!"
At that, Kaiden couldn’t help but burst out laughing, and the Valkyries weren’t far behind. None of them expected this serious researcher oddball to curse like that.
"You really don’t hold back, huh?" he chuckled.

Nyx nudged her big chest forward as she leaned in, resting them on top of Kaiden’s scalp as she asked with a knowing smile, letting her social butterfly persona shine brightly, "Hey, Riven? If it’s not too much trouble... would you mind giving us a little tour sometime? Y’know, of the stuff you have figured out? Frankly, we’ve been recently thrown into the world of awakened, so if a knowledgeable one could educate us a bit about artifacts, well, that certainly wouldn’t hurt..."

The black-haired, lacey underwear-wearing woman blinked in surprise, then beamed. "You want to see it?" she asked, a little breathless, as if the idea of someone asking to hear her ramble about tech was the highest praise imaginable.
Before she could even answer, Rae slammed a palm against her back with a hearty laugh, nearly knocking her over again.
"Hah! Look at you, Riv. I knew you weren’t a hopeless hermit who could only get along with her twin sister." Rae grinned at her like a proud mom.
Kaiden raised a brow at the unexpected revelation, but before he could ask, the Valkyries shouted in perfect unison:
"Twin sister?!"
Riven’s entire body jolted forward after being slapped once again, her tablet flipping from her grip as she turned with a slow, glacial stare toward Rae. Her voice was pure ice.
"I do not appreciate being slapped like a malfunctioning golem. And I can socialize just fine! I simply prefer the company of my tools and creations..."

Rae just laughed, brushing off her sister’s death glare with an infuriatingly cheerful, "Sure, sure," before flashing a wicked grin toward Kaiden and the Valkyries, who still looked stunned at the revelation.

"I get your surprise," Rae nodded along sagely, raising a finger and pointing to herself. "A wild, sexy, tanned chick..." Then she pointed to Riven. "Pale as a ghost... All too pure like freshly fallen snow."

She then continued voicing the many differences between her and her sister by cupping her hands under her breasts and pushing them up, displaying her rather modest feminine assets with no shame, and gave them an appreciative look.

"Small boobies... but they’re perfect. Light, aerodynamic. I don’t need back pain in my life, though with my Strength stat, I probably wouldn’t anyhow, but let’s ignore such matters, shall we? I’d rather sprint through a battlefield feeling light and tight than lug around those giant udders of hers."

Riven’s jaw dropped, her entire face heating up like a kettle at her unabashed sister’s lack of a mouth filter. "Udders?!" she sputtered, arms folding over her generous cleavage, though it only made them look bigger under the open lab coat and sexy bras.
Rae once again ignored her sister as she wasn’t done noting her observations.

"Big, sexy muscles~" she declared with a proud flex of her biceps. "Years of training, no skipped arm days." Then she reached out with practiced swiftness and pinched a bit of squishy softness on her Riven’s lower belly.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Differences Between Twins
paragraphs: She didn’t even say anything.
Just grimaced, dramatically, like she’d uncovered forbidden knowledge.

"Hey!" Riven slapped her hand away and turned an even deeper shade of pink. "You’re the one who keeps inhaling instant ramen, guzzling soda, and watching trashy shows all day during our off-hours, but I’m the one who picks up the weight?! The world is so damn unfair!"

Nyx giggled and leaned forward suggestively, replanting her own two big breasts on Kaiden’s head, her hands still gently working his shoulders as she declared, "Don’t worry, Riven. Men with actual good taste like a little extra softness on their women..."
Then she glanced slyly at Luna and added with a smirk, "...A little more meat to grip onto and suckle on to their heart’s content, you know?"
Luna snorted at the obvious jab and responded by immediately flashing a middle finger into the air toward Nyx without looking, the classic Storm Valkyrie response.

Kaiden chuckled at the entire exchange, loving how naturally the chaos flowed between the new additions and his beloved Valkyries. Somehow, in a very dysfunctional way, it all just worked. His girls were already working on getting the rather closed-off Riven to open up, while Rae seemed like a party girl who would not struggle one bit in finding her place among his admittedly similarly somewhat quirky gals.
Satisfied, he leaned back into the plush couch, enjoying the view of the half-naked siblings bickering while his girls settled into the environment like they’d lived there forever.
The mood was light, the air full of banter and teasing... until Aria suddenly slapped her thighs with a sharp smack that echoed through the room.
Her beautiful, silvery eyes turned urgent.
"Wait! What about my family?"
Everyone paused, turning to look at her as she abruptly sat up straighter on Kaiden’s lap.

"I mean... If we’re being moved to a literal defensive bunker because there’s such a grave potential threat to us, then what about them? My mom, my sister, my little brother... They’d be the easiest way to get to me, and therefore to all of us!" she exclaimed, panic rising in her voice with each passing moment. "What if someone already...?!"
Without waiting, she sprang off Kaiden’s lap and practically sprinted toward the hallway, right in the comms room’s direction.
"I need to call Grace! I need to know if they’re okay!"
But before she could disappear out of sight, Riven’s voice rang out.
"I’ll contact her for you."

Aria paused mid-stride as Riven tapped her tablet, already in motion. Her fingers moved deftly across the glowing screen, navigating through several encrypted channels. Her glasses reflected layers of data streaming by in polished lines of code. Within seconds, a soft ping sounded as a secured connection stabilized, and Grace’s voice flowed from the speakers in that always-polished, faintly exasperated tone:
"Unless you or your wonderful sister have already set something on fire, what’s the emergency?"
Riven adjusted her glasses with a small push of her finger. "Negative. Aria Levander is concerned about the safety arrangements regarding her family members."
A pause came from the other end of the line.
Then a long, quiet sigh from Grace.
"...Of course she is."
There was a rustle on the other end. Grace sounded like she was massaging her temples.
"Well... Before we could arrange official extraction for the Levander family, they were... ’acquired’ by a certain individual."
Kaiden’s eyes narrowed. Aria gasped with both of her hands flying to her mouth, her heart almost having stopped right then and there.

Grace continued, unaware of the extreme panic she’d just caused with her poorly chosen words. "A certain Shadow Monarch decided to get involved before we could. She relocated Aria’s mother, sister, and younger brother to her personal villa. She extended a very firm—read: non-negotiable—’invitation’."
Aria blinked, the rapid beating of her overworked heart lessening slightly. "Vespera...?"

"Correct," Grace said, sighing again. "The chairman tried to move them into neutral protection zones, but the Shadow Monarch wasn’t... open to discussion. She said, and I quote, ’I’d like to spend quality bonding time with my fellow future mother-in-law. She seems like a lovely woman. I also need to work on my public image; everyone keeps calling me a stone-faced murder machine, so maybe some normal human interaction will help.’"
For a moment, nobody spoke.
Then Aria slowly exhaled a massive breath of relief and dropped to her knees, pressing a hand to her heart.

"Oh, thank God..." she murmured. "If they’re with Vespera, then it’s all good... That woman could make a demon lord piss himself with a mere look. I trust her way more with my loved one’s protection than any random corrupt government agent."
"..." Grace remained silent upon hearing Aria’s statement.

Kaiden smiled, planting Luna on the armrest before standing to raise Aria into a princess hold and returning to the sofa. Once comfortably seated, he resumed stroking her and Luna’s thighs as he said, "She’ll protect them as if they were her own. You don’t have to worry."
But Rae and Riven?
The strange pair of sisters had gone still. Silent. Both looked like they’d just swallowed a live grenade.
Their eyes darted from the screen to Kaiden.
Then to each other.
Then back to Kaiden again.
And then, slowly, they turned their necks in sync toward him, blinking furiously, minds racing to catch up to what they’d just heard.
Finally, in perfect unison, they gasped:
"The Shadow Monarch is your mother?!"
Kaiden couldn’t help but smirk amusedly at the synchronized shriek from the twins. The name Vespera Ashborn carried quite the meaning with it.
He leaned back into Nyx’s comforting hands with Aria and Luna still curled in his arms, and stroked their sensual thighs affectionately.
"Yeah..." he revealed without wanting to hide anything, knowing the gov was already painfully aware of his identity, grinning from ear to ear.
He then continued with a wry expression, "But while I might’ve popped out of that woman’s womb... Let’s just say our relationship is ’a bit’ complicated."

I still love my mother as well, despite her being the one who disowned me. It’s just... Our relationship is a little hard to describe now."
Riven’s mouth parted, but no sound came out. Her face said error 404: mental processing failed. Even her fingers twitched on her tablet, like her system had frozen up.

Aria’s eyes immediately narrowed into twin slits of jealous lightning upon her brains picked up on Rae’s words.
She slid her hand up Kaiden’s chest like she was staking a claim, and her voice dropped into a tone of soft, possessive sweetness that had an edge of knives behind it.
"Kai," she said with a tight smile aimed at the white haired, tanned girl, "isn’t looking for any new girlfriends."
Kaiden’s hand paused on her juicy thigh for a moment before resuming, amused by how natural her cute threat felt.

Rae held her hands up defensively, still grinning like a devil. "Woah, woah, relax, Miss Yandere In A Gentle Girl’s Unassuming Skin. I’m not trying to join the harem. In fact, I’m not looking for any romantic relationship to begin with."

"I’m married to chaos, caffeine, and free life," she said, voice velvety with smug amusement. "I don’t need a man in my life. Relationships? Effort. Emotional commitment? Paperwork. My only sacred vow is to never sign anything that requires ’shared toothbrush space.’"

She flicked her fingers airily, then grinned. "Besides, your guy’s got his hands very full already, doesn’t he? Or are you girls just rookies? Are you seriously telling me, even with three of you working him over, you still can’t squeeze him dry? You surely don’t need little old me to help you out, right? Surely not! After all..."

The cheeky woman lifted a finger and began counting off. "The storm goblin on his left, the sexy magic machine clinging to his lap, and the curvy space goddess back there... and then there’s that human-sized, tanned, soft-as-hell catgirl sunbathing outside like she’s posing for a beach commercial. If the video circulating the whole world is anything to go by, she’s ready to do her part, so..." Rae gave a low whistle. "Can he even take you all on?"

Riven hissed, jerking slightly beneath her sister’s arm. "Would you shut your trap finally? You’re being incredibly rude! We just met these people, and not only are they official clients, but can you not treat them as if you’ve known them since elementary school?!"
But despite the curvy researcher’s words, Luna didn’t even blink.

"First of all, if you want to lead a long and healthy life even after I get some more levels under my belt, I recommend you don’t call me a storm goblin ever again... As for your statement... My answer is: Not really," she admitted with total deadpan calm as if she were discussing her favorite chocolate flavor.

Luna paused for a mere moment to collect her thoughts before she continued, "Kaiden’s not exactly any other man. You should think of squeezing him dry as more of a grand raid boss challenge than a fun little activity done whenever and wherever you feel like it. Based on what the internet tells me, most men collapse after round two if not one... He just asks us if we’re done warming up after the fifth..."
She crossed her arms and added unapologetically, "Don’t compare him to those small dicked losers you see on the net."
Nyx let out a soft hum, twirling a strand of her pink hair.

"I gotta agree with my petite bestie..." she said with absolutely zero shame. "Kai’s... uniquely built. Perfect stamina. Silky control. Really knows how to fill in the gaps and please the female body..."
Her eyes slid toward Rae, and she gave a sly wink. "If you ever get bored of the battlefield and feel like testing yourself against something truly worthy of your chaos, you know where to find us."
Before Rae could respond, Nyx smoothly pivoted, her gaze turning on Riven like a slow-moving laser.

"And you," she purred, voice sultry and suggestive, "if you ever get tired of studying cold metal and soulless constructs... my man’s a one-of-a-kind specimen. I think you’d find him... extremely stimulating under the microscope."
She punctuated it with a knowing wink and an even more sinful smile.
Riven flushed hard, her lips parting in horror and fascination all at once. "!!! I’m... fine... with my non-organic projects, thank you..."
Nyx’s sultry smile was still stretched across her lips when she suddenly froze, from one moment to the next.
Because across from her, Aria had turned her head in perfect silence. Her eyes were glowing faintly... Not with mana, but with something far, far more dangerous.
Possessiveness.
Feminine rage.
Yandere-level fury.
It wasn’t loud. It wasn’t dramatic. There was no yelling, no growling, no obvious threat.
Just a slow turn... and a look that said ’I will personally erase you from the gene pool if you keep offering what’s MINE on a silver platter as if Kai were an all-inclusive meal.’

Luna, ever the storm behind the calm, added her own silent glare to the moment with her arms folded, her foot tapping against the floor like a countdown timer. She didn’t look as murderous as Aria did, but the message was still clear: ’Kai is already gonna dick down even more monster bitches, so don’t even think about expanding the roster of your own accord, you damned freaky slut. Whatever your kinks are, we’re not interested.’
Nyx’s confident smirk faltered.

It’s just...
Our relationship is a little hard to describe now."
Riven’s mouth parted, but no sound came out.

Rae held her hands up defensively, still grinning like a devil.

I’m not trying to join the harem.

Relationships?
Effort.
Emotional commitment?
Paperwork.

Surely not!
After all..."
The cheeky woman lifted a finger and began counting off.

"The storm goblin on his left, the sexy magic machine clinging to his lap, and the curvy space goddess back there... and then there’s that human-sized, tanned, soft-as-hell catgirl sunbathing outside like she’s posing for a beach commercial.

He just asks us if we’re done warming up after the fifth..."

chapters.title: Chapter 171: The Yandere is Growing!
paragraphs: Her shoulders stiffened. Her hands, still resting on Kaiden’s shoulders, trembled just the tiniest bit.
"... Okaaay," she said carefully, sweating like a pink-haired fox caught in a bear trap. "Didn’t mean to provoke the royal wrath... holy hell..."

She tried to retreat, but then she realized that the best defense was a good offense, so she stepped forward instead of backward. Her hands slid off Kaiden’s shoulders and down to Aria’s, giving them a slow, careful squeeze.
"Just... calming down the volcano..." she muttered nervously.
Aria didn’t blink.
Her gaze was still ice and daggers.
Nyx gulped, glancing sideways at Kaiden in silent ’help me!’ panic.

Kaiden responded with a quiet, low chuckle. Then, without wasting another word, he shifted in his seat slightly and leaned in toward Aria, brushing aside a silvery strand of her gorgeous hair. It was time he helped his Space Valkyrie out, so...
A loving kiss landed on the Moon Valkyrie’s cheek, soft and deliberate.
Then another. Lower. Warm lips pressed into the sensitive curve of her neck, plush and lingering.
Aria visibly tensed... then shivered.
Her glare, sharp enough to pierce steel moments before, began to flicker. That frigid, territorial glint in her eyes dulled ever so slightly.

Kaiden leaned in again, this time nuzzling beneath her ear before pressing a third kiss there, as slow and intimate as he could muster. He knew perfectly well how much Aria loved these tender gestures of his.
And just as he expected, his actions quickly brought results when her fingers clenched around his sleeve.
A tiny, almost imperceptible twitch curved at the corner of her lips. Not quite a smile. But it was no longer the earlier scowl either.
Then came the huff. Low. Frustrated. And grudgingly charmed.
She finally, finally looked away from Nyx.

"...You’re lucky Kai’s here, Pink Bimbo..." she muttered under her breath, voice honeyed with menace. Her tone dripped with all the murderous restraint of a queen holding back divine judgment... for now.

Nyx didn’t miss a beat. "Duly noted..." she squeaked, massaging faster and more delicately, her hands moving with the terrified precision of a mouse tiptoeing through a lion’s den. "You’re a vision. A gift. My radiant favorite bestie. Please don’t vaporize me with an ’accidentally’ misfired [Lunar Overload] during our next dungeon undertaking, alright...?"
From the couch, Luna gave an amused sigh and propped her elbow on the armrest, resting her chin in her palm. "The Princess is getting more possessive by the day, isn’t she...?"
"... Yep," Nyx nodded along firmly, not daring to lift her head. "Did you see the way her eyes flicked red? That was a death glare critical mass. I almost let out a little pee..."

Luna couldn’t help but stare dryly at the all too honest girl for a few seconds before she elected to ignore Nyx and began humming under her breath, thoughtful now. "Not surprising though... Honestly, it makes perfect sense if you think about it. Back when we first met her, Aria was the typical cliche sweet young girl... With her own little quirks here and there, but that didn’t change the fact that she was a naïve young woman who got totally smitten with the idea of Kaiden. She had that whole proper, fairytale princess aura going on."
Nyx slowly nodded along sagely, keeping her hands moving. "Right? Like a storybook crush."

"But feelings evolve," Luna continued. "And when you go through real-life death battles, dungeon raids, near-death nights... When he saves your mother from dying as a horribly mistreated prostitute in a disgusting brothel with an even more disgusting man keeping her hostage, it stops being fantasy. It turns into something else. Something deeper. Aria doesn’t just love Kaiden anymore... Her feelings are not just those of a young, innocent woman who fell for the first time... She needs him. Like air. Like gravity."
"...And gravity doesn’t share," Nyx whispered fearfully.
Luna tilted her head, observing Aria with keen eyes. "Nope. Gravity pulls everything inward and doesn’t let go."
There was a beat of silence. Then Nyx’s eyes widened with growing horror.
"But it’s only been a few days since we all got together! If she’s this far gone now..." Nyx paled, visibly starting to sweat. "...What’s she gonna be like ten years from now?!"
Luna slowly leaned back against Kaiden’s chest, arms crossed over her delicate breasts as she let out a long, tired sigh.
"...Your guess is as good as mine."
"Hmph!" came a sudden scoff.

Aria turned in Kaiden’s arms with a pout, elegant and regal and just a touch theatrical. She folded her arms, but didn’t pull away, her back now snugly nestled against his muscular chest, her face still slightly flushed from the onslaught of kisses she’d just been assaulted with.
Annoyance still clung to her aura, but it was no longer scorching. It simmered now, like a low-burning flame wrapped in silk.
Clearly, she was still annoyed.
But under Kaiden’s steady warmth enveloping her?
She was also melting. Just a little. Okay, quite a bit
And she hated how much she loved it.
Off to the side, Rae had propped her feet up and was watching the entire scene like it was the best sitcom she’d ever seen.
She let out a low whistle while grinning like the devil in female form.
She sent Kaiden an amazed glance, as if she had just now understood how troublesome his job of keeping his home harmonious was. "Well damn! You’re not the only interesting one in this house, huh?"
Her eyes danced across Aria’s cold glare, Luna’s brooding silence, and Nyx’s shivering attempt at damage control. "I didn’t expect this kind of chaos. You’re living with a lethal combo."
Kaiden smiled as he pulled Aria tighter into his lap, nuzzling her cheek.
"You have no idea. But I wouldn’t have it any other way."
And Rae?
She just chuckled under her breath and clinked an imaginary glass in Kaiden’s direction. "It’s certainly not for me, but you’re living the life, my guy. Respect."

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Classes and Levels
paragraphs: Aria let out an unimpressed scoff at Rae’s comment, one elegantly arched brow rising like a queen unimpressed with the court jester before her. Then, she shifted her position with one long, sensual leg crossing slowly over the other with the kind of poised grace that only added to her regal menace.

Her voice softened, but the edge remained. "On a more important note, there are only four bedrooms in this house. From what I gather, you two plan on staying here as part of our protection detail, so we’ll need to make some adjustments."
Rae blinked, then waved a hand as if brushing off a dust mote. "Nah. Don’t worry about us. I’ll just crash on the couch. Honestly, I sleep wherever I drop. As for my dear sis..."
She tilted her head toward Riven, who was already half out of the conversation, busy quietly fiddling with a small mechanical component in her palm, eyes far away in blueprint land.

"... she’s probably already mentally converting your basement into a high-tech lab-slash-bunker of her own. She’ll never sleep if she’s got projects to tinker with, so no need to waste a room on little old us."
But Aria shook her head with her expression softening, just a little.

"No. I wouldn’t feel right asking you both to risk your lives for us while not even offering a proper room in exchange. You deserve at least that much." Her voice dropped into a more possessive, but warm register. "I don’t need one. I’ll sleep in Kaiden’s anyway. So... you can take mine."
"Same," Nyx added with a breezy wink, already relaxing against Kaiden’s back again. "I was never intending to live in my room anyway. I’ll be staying in the harem suite, naturally."

Luna nodded calmly, though her arm snaked tighter around Kaiden’s waist. "You can have mine too... Originally, I wanted to have my gamer room, but I’m not so sure anymore... The stakes might be a bit too high for me to sit back and leisurely play video games anyway."
"We’ll see what to do about that, don’t you worry, Luna," Kaiden replied, stroking her lush purple hair before he looked around at the sudden and very generous surrender of private space.
Kaiden chuckled, clearly amused, as he stretched an arm across the back of either girl on his legs.

"Well," he said, glancing around at the group, "now we’ve got too many rooms freed up. Let’s not overthink it. Just go with the flow, I say. If anyone needs more personal space, just speak up. We’ll adjust accordingly."

He gave a lopsided grin. "We’re not posh old losers in fancy suits with trust funds and platinum pillows. This isn’t some billionaires’ retreat with rooms scented by imported moonlotus and beds that adjust to your blood pressure."

Luna stifled a small giggle under his arm. She continued, looking at him with eyes full of adoration. "That’s right... We don’t need gold-plated jacuzzis or hand-fed grapes from a temple orchard. We’re not ancient aristocrats with fragile bones that need climate-controlled oxygen rooms. We’re fighters. Survivors. A little chaos, a little closeness, and a few missing doors won’t kill us."
Rae let out a loud bark of laughter. "Damn right. And here I thought I was the only one who thought luxury was a scam for the bored and wrinkled."
Even Riven’s lips twitched, like she was suppressing a smile.
One by one, small smiles passed around the room as the vibe settled into something... surprisingly warm. For all the madness and flirtation, there was a calm undercurrent of mutual respect.
Kaiden leaned back, enjoying the hum of comfortable silence that filled the air for a moment. Then he tilted his head, eyes flicking to the new duo.
"I’ve got a question of my own, if I may."
Rae glanced up with a raised brow. "Shoot."

"What are your classes?" Kaiden asked, his tone casual, yet laced with keen interest. "And your levels?" He thought he’d get this information in before he looked at his own status window to finally assess his gains from the Bastet video.
The entire room went quiet.
Riven finally paused her tinkering, looking up at him with unreadable eyes.
Rae’s smile widened with a mischievous glint flashing in her bright eyes as she leaned forward and rested her elbows on her knees.
"Oooh~" she purred, voice playful yet laced with anticipation. "Now that’s a spicy question..."

She chuckled low in her throat, the sound more like a devil’s drumroll than a laugh. "You know, I might enjoy lounging on a comfy couch in such fun company, but I still much prefer getting some outdoors action."
She kicked one up, flexing her toned leg with zero shame.
"So instead of boring you with even more mundane chatting of words and numbers..." she added with a smirk, "how about a showcase instead-"
"Level 72, A-Tier Awakened."
The voice cut through the room like a scalpel, sharp, smooth, and utterly unbothered.
Rae’s smirk froze instantly.
All heads turned.
Riven hadn’t even looked up.

Seated cross-legged on her comfy sofa, the interestingly dressed woman calmly swiped across her tablet from time to time, making the soft flick of her finger against the glass sound across the room. Her voice remained flat, composed, and clinically precise, like she was reading from a grocery list instead of casually dropping their critical information.

"Rae and I share a unique class dynamic born from our twin-based resonance. Our bloodline synchronization generates mutual energy harmonics that unlock synergistic evolution between our respective classes."
She paused, tapped a schematic, then continued.
"I have the Constructrix class."
Rae gave an exaggerated sigh and slumped sideways, flopping onto Riven’s form defeatedly. "Sis..."

"Primary focus: Summoning autonomous or semi-autonomous constructs, battlefield fortification, enhancing material integrity, defensive utility, and regulating power flow input from Rae’s chaos output."
Another swipe of Riven’s fingers came.
"Rae has the Rendrix class."
Now she looked up. Just barely enough to check if they were following along with her detailing.

"Primary focus: Material deconstruction, energy redirection, environmental destabilization, and systemic weakening. She breaks it. I build it. She disassembles mass. I reroute output. Her chaos charges my circuits."
Rae groaned into a pillow. "You’re ruining my fun, Riven."

Riven didn’t blink at being accused. "You were behaving very shamelessly. Just because you’re already bored doesn’t mean you should nag others to entertain you. Your TV will get here soon. Bear with it until then."
"Ugh!" Rae flailed in defeat.
"I like her a lot," Luna whispered, eyes on Riven, impressed.
"Same! Both of them are badasses, just in different ways," Nyx whispered back.
Aria, meanwhile, observed the twins with new curiosity, tilting her head slightly. "So your synergy isn’t just metaphorical?"

"No," Riven replied flatly, now adjusting the 3D model of what looked like a modular turret with glowing coils. "Her existence literally powers my best work. Rae’s energy output is erratic but massive. I refine it into stabilized constructs. Together, we function as an entropy loop."
"...We make beautiful disasters together," Rae chirped while giving Riven a big sisterly hug.
Kaiden chuckled, shaking his head. "So you’re chaos and control."
With his little information gathering completed, it was time to check his gains and move forward, capitalizing on their current immense fame! He was ready to rock the world a second time!

A little chaos, a little closeness, and a few missing doors won’t kill us."
Rae let out a loud bark of laughter.
"Damn right.
And here I thought I was the only one who thought luxury was a scam for the bored and wrinkled."
Even Riven’s lips twitched, like she was suppressing a smile.
One by one, small smiles passed around the room as the vibe settled into something... surprisingly warm.
For all the madness and flirtation, there was a calm undercurrent of mutual respect.
Kaiden leaned back, enjoying the hum of comfortable silence that filled the air for a moment.
Then he tilted his head, eyes flicking to the new duo.
"I’ve got a question of my own, if I may."
Rae glanced up with a raised brow.
"Shoot."
"What are your classes?" Kaiden asked, his tone casual, yet laced with keen interest.
"And your levels?" He thought he’d get this information in before he looked at his own status window to finally assess his gains from the Bastet video.
The entire room went quiet.
Riven finally paused her tinkering, looking up at him with unreadable eyes.
Rae’s smile widened with a mischievous glint flashing in her bright eyes as she leaned forward and rested her elbows on her knees.
"Oooh~" she purred, voice playful yet laced with anticipation.
"Now that’s a spicy question..."
She chuckled low in her throat, the sound more like a devil’s drumroll than a laugh.
"You know, I might enjoy lounging on a comfy couch in such fun company, but I still much prefer getting some outdoors action."
She kicked one up, flexing her toned leg with zero shame.
"So instead of boring you with even more mundane chatting of words and numbers..." she added with a smirk, "how about a showcase instead-"
"Level 72, A-Tier Awakened."
The voice cut through the room like a scalpel, sharp, smooth, and utterly unbothered.
Rae’s smirk froze instantly.
All heads turned.
Riven hadn’t even looked up.
Seated cross-legged on her comfy sofa, the interestingly dressed woman calmly swiped across her tablet from time to time, making the soft flick of her finger against the glass sound across the room.
Her voice remained flat, composed, and clinically precise, like she was reading from a grocery list instead of casually dropping their critical information.
"Rae and I share a unique class dynamic born from our twin-based resonance.
Our bloodline synchronization generates mutual energy harmonics that unlock synergistic evolution between our respective classes."
She paused, tapped a schematic, then continued.
"I have the Constructrix class."
Rae gave an exaggerated sigh and slumped sideways, flopping onto Riven’s form defeatedly.

"Primary focus: Summoning autonomous or semi-autonomous constructs, battlefield fortification, enhancing material integrity, defensive utility, and regulating power flow input from Rae’s chaos output."
Another swipe of Riven’s fingers came.
"Rae has the Rendrix class."
Now she looked up.
Just barely enough to check if they were following along with her detailing.
"Primary focus: Material deconstruction, energy redirection, environmental destabilization, and systemic weakening.
She breaks it.
I build it.
She disassembles mass.
I reroute output.
Her chaos charges my circuits."
Rae groaned into a pillow.
"You’re ruining my fun, Riven."
Riven didn’t blink at being accused.
"You were behaving very shamelessly.
Just because you’re already bored doesn’t mean you should nag others to entertain you.
Your TV will get here soon.
Bear with it until then."
"Ugh!" Rae flailed in defeat.
"I like her a lot," Luna whispered, eyes on Riven, impressed.
"Same!
Both of them are badasses, just in different ways," Nyx whispered back.
Aria, meanwhile, observed the twins with new curiosity, tilting her head slightly.
"So your synergy isn’t just metaphorical?"
"No," Riven replied flatly, now adjusting the 3D model of what looked like a modular turret with glowing coils.
"Her existence literally powers my best work.
Rae’s energy output is erratic but massive.
I refine it into stabilized constructs.
Together, we function as an entropy loop."
"...We make beautiful disasters together," Rae chirped while giving Riven a big sisterly hug.
Kaiden chuckled, shaking his head.
"So you’re chaos and control."
With his little information gathering completed, it was time to check his gains and move forward, capitalizing on their current immense fame!
He was ready to rock the world a second time!

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Sync Class
paragraphs: Kaiden leaned back into the couch, arms stretched behind Aria and Luna as Rae and Riven wrapped up their unexpected info drop. His smile lingered, but his thoughts drifted.
Level 72. A-Tier Awakened. Both of them.

That put the twins just below the true monsters, the rare S-Tiers that sat at the top of the food chain. Powerhouses capable of shifting battlefields by themselves. It was an elite bracket that only a handful of people in the country could even dream of.
Kaiden exhaled slowly.
Riven and Rae were strong. Incredibly strong. But not invincible.
That was important to remember.

Still, Kaiden wasn’t ungrateful. Quite the opposite. For what it was worth, the government had done a lot. They’d provided this high-tech house. A reinforced bunker disguised as a basement. Equipment, surveillance protections, a direct line to federal support... and now these two absurdly powerful bodyguard twins.
But Kaiden wasn’t naïve enough to think all of this was purely for his safety.
They weren’t just protecting him and the girls.
They were watching them.

The USA got next to nothing from him or his team. Not loyalty, not allegiance, not taxes, not even direct cooperation. They weren’t registered members of any domestic guild, association, or research initiative. Just private citizens with too many unknowns.
So really, from the government’s point of view, this whole setup wasn’t charity.
It was containment.
A comfortable cage with nice furniture.

Kaiden glanced toward the hallway. It wasn’t just a bunker: it was probably lined with enough scanners, sensors, and passive surveillance tech to feed a month’s worth of data into whatever black site lab had clearance for their case files.
And Riven and Rae?

They weren’t exactly prison wardens, but they weren’t here solely to play bodyguard either, he was sure of it. He liked the pair a lot, but if they didn’t have instructions to ’keep an eye on them,’ then he would be shocked to the very core.

Kaiden could swiftly decipher the thought process of the Awakened Association in assigning them these protections. If someone small-time came sniffing around, the twins would crush them before the alarm even blared. They could protect Valhalla’s Sinners from almost all threats, and they could sleep in peace in the bunker’s safe walls.
But if something serious came knocking? A black-ops team. An S-tier threat. A foreign nation’s elite strike squad?
Then all they’d be really good for is stalling.

Buy time. Raise the alarm. Hold the line just long enough for the real hitters of the USA to mobilize. Because giving a team like his 24/7 protection by true S-rankers? That just wasn’t going to happen.
Scarlet, the Flame Monarch?

She wasn’t going to spend her days standing on Kaiden’s porch with a clipboard and sunglasses. People like her were treated as national assets, used sparingly and strategically, not babysitting unaligned wildcards. Furthermore, she wasn’t even a government agent but a free awakened, hiring her services for such a work would’ve likely bankrupted the country sooner or later.
But despite this, Kaiden smiled faintly to himself.
Why?
Because this was fine.

He didn’t expect to be given anything more. Not when they were still flying so far outside the system’s lines. He was just glad the current arrangement didn’t come with more strings or veiled threats.

The only thing he had to give up was privacy. And sure, it stung badly, but compared to being kidnapped, dissected, or drafted? That was a bargain. They could retake their privacy once they were strong enough to protect themselves.
He looked toward the twins again. Rae’s mischievous grin as she was sending little kisses to Riven’s unamused cheeks, who was trying to throw the tanned woman off of her.
Kaiden gave a quiet nod to himself.
This was good. He could work with this.
Then, for just the briefest of moments, he mulled over the other information he learned about the newcomer pair.
Constructrix and Rendrix.

Kaiden turned the names over in his mind like puzzle pieces that didn’t quite fit yet. He couldn’t say much about what they were truly capable of, not without seeing them in action, but the way Riven had described their dynamic left no doubt.
A sync class duo.
Classes that weren’t just complementary, but designed to function together. Like two halves of a living machine.
Riven built, Rae broke. One created order, the other thrived in chaos. Individually strong, maybe, but together? Something significantly more terrifying.
That kind of synergy wasn’t common.
But it wasn’t unheard of.
In a strange way... his own team was a version of that.

His Valkyries... their classes had been born from him. From his bond with each of them. Aria, Luna, Nyx... their strength didn’t come from external awakenings. It came from him. From his system. His growth.
But their classes weren’t tethered the same way he expected Riven and Rae to be. At least, not exactly.
They didn’t need to be right beside him to fight at full strength. Their powers didn’t short-circuit if he stepped out of the room.
If he had to guess... even if he died, they’d probably still keep their powers.
Probably.
But there was no telling for sure. The system was unpredictable. And the bond they shared... it wasn’t just emotional. It was something deeper. Magical. Structural.
He exhaled slowly, mulling over the contrast.
Riven and Rae were bound by blood. Structure. Specialization.
His Valkyries were bound by him.
By belief. By love. By whatever strange rules his system decided to follow.
’Well, with that out of the way... Let’s see,’ he thought inwardly, glancing at the clock on the wall.

’It’s been about 12 hours since I uploaded the video. Most of the world should’ve already been notified of what had happened, as from what I’d been told, we’ve been making the news all over the globe... Well, some dictatorships did do their best to censor the news, such as the damned Chinese... So no 1.4 billion viewers by default...’
His hands formed into tight fists, and he suddenly felt a very strong urge to deliver a strong punch to a certain Winnie the Pooh-looking prime minister, but he calmed his heart.

’Don’t get greedy, Kaiden... You can’t have it all... Well, you can, but only once you become strong enough. Anyhow. Thanks to the widespread media coverage, the biggest burst of views my monster subjugation video gathers will have already arrived. Of course, it’ll keep growing greatly in the future, too... hehehe...’
Having finished his inner thoughts, Kaiden stretched his arms with a lazy grin.
"Alright, girls... Let’s do this together."

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Incredible Gains
paragraphs: "Alright, girls... Let’s do this together."
He didn’t need to say more.

They instantly understood, having been waiting for his go-ahead for a long time now. They each agreed to do this together once they got home, but thanks to Grace ambushing them with her two bodyguards, they got a bit sidetracked.
Without another word, the Valkyries focused inwardly, each of them accessing their systemic interface.
In unison, they navigated to the Awakened Media Platform, quickly finding the channel labeled Valhalla’s Sinners. And there it was.
’Taming a Sexy Boss Monster’
Uploaded 12 hours ago. Thumbnail: sultry. Title: intentionally clickbaity.
Classic Kaiden.
The moment the video opened, the view count loaded...
For a second, the room went still.
Then...
Aria, nestled against his side, just... froze.
Her glowing silver eyes locked onto the number, lips parted, brain clearly buffering. She went so still Kaiden briefly wondered if she’d glitched.
"...Aria?" he asked, nudging her shoulder.
Nothing.
She just... blinked very slowly.
Meanwhile, behind the couch, Nyx exploded.

"YEEEEEEESSSS!" she screamed, doing an excited hop in place before launching herself into a chaotic victory dance. "We broke three hundred million?! In less than a day?! The BTS twinks only gained 143 million views with their most viral video, and that took them 24 hours! Do you guys understand what that means?! We’re more viral than any of the pre-mana apocalypse superstars!"
She nearly tripped on her own feet as she spun behind the furniture, arms flailing like an overjoyed maniac.
Kaiden laughed with an incredibly big grin adorning his face, his heart beating from excitement so fast he felt it might just jump out of his chest.
And then he turned to see the final reaction of his Valkyries...
Luna didn’t scream or shout.
She just smirked. Wider than ever before.
That smug, knowing, confident smirk that told him she knew this would happen.
Lifting one hand, she held it up at just the right angle.
Kaiden met it with a firm, resounding high five.
The echo of the clap filled the room.
"Victory tastes sweet," Luna declared, eyes glinting with amusement.
And Aria, still in his arms, finally stirred.
She blinked again. Then very softly whispered, "...three hundred and forty-two million... That’s basically the whole United States!"
She tried to stand, perhaps to walk it all off, but her legs instantly gave out, making the Moon Valkyrie slump back into his hold, landing her perky butt on his lap.
Kaiden grinned at the girl’s adorable sight as he wrapped his arm around her waist to support her.

Now came the time to pay the price of his sudden loss of privacy... As he couldn’t trust either the twins or the equipment of their new home not to spy on him, he couldn’t discuss the Demonic Pornstar System’s unique stuff with his girls openly like he had beforehand.

Technically, he could use the Awakened Platform’s social tab to send them messages or even conduct a call, but he didn’t quite trust it enough to do so. There have been no public cases of someone cracking a private line, but he didn’t want to be the first victim. There was certainly going to be a myriad of strong people trying to do just that to him now.

Furthermore, he didn’t quite trust the Awakened Platform itself all too much either, as from what he could tell, they were part of the universal system that suddenly hit Earth alongside the arrival of the mana apocalypse... And considering that the Heavenly Demon openly rebelled against the universe and its laws, he didn’t quite know if the universal system would treat the Heavenly Demon’s successor well.
Be that as it may, it was time to check his gains. He first checked his status window, ignoring the three important system stats.
[Name: Kaiden Grey]
[Rank: 2 - Budding Star]
[Class: Paragon of Sin]
[Stats]
{Vitality: 50}
{Strength: 53}
{Agility: 52}
{Endurance: 52}
{Mana: 10}
{Magic: 10}
[Sinsworn Valkyries]
< Luna Aster >
< Aria Levander >
< Nyx Cosmos >
[Skills]
- [Silent Casting] (???-tier)
- [Omni Cock] (SSS-tier)
- [Monster Girl Subjugator] (S-tier)
- [Adaptive Reflexes] (B-tier)
- [Harem Vision] (D-tier)
- [Remove Her Inhibitions] (E-tier)

After slaying Bastet’s Royal Guard, he hit level 16. As he was still a primary melee fighter, he was focusing on his physical stats. Mana and Magic would have to wait until he got a new sin stance that focused more on spells... Which one will ideally happen very, very soon...
Now, for his three unique system stats... They looked as such before today:
[Views: 1.36 million]
[Fangirls: 111]
[Income: 222]
Views were the least exciting as he’d already spoiled the fun by checking the video’s views.
[Views: 1.36 million ➢ 343.8 million]
Even though Kaiden knew what to expect, his breath still caught for a moment. This jump was simply astronomical.
As for income...

Kaiden had cut the boss fight video into a blood-pumping, 30-minute-long video, which he uploaded. Considering that income on the Awakened Media Platfrom came from hours watched and not simply video views, he was initially debating doing less cutting so that he could put out a very long video which he was sure many would still watch, but even now, even during this unique opportunity, he was looking ahead into the future.

Sure, in the short term, uploading a 3-hour-long video, if not longer, of the whole ordeal could’ve given them more benefits. More watch hours, higher income statistics. But that would mean a less interesting video under the banner of Valhalla’s Sinners.

The reason he went for the well-cut, much more interesting shorter form factor was that he was still in the fan-gathering mindset, not the fan-milking one. He’d rather truly impress 100 people so much so they want to know more about him and Valhalla’s Sinners than have the same 100 people watch a longer video and be like ’Damn, that’s pretty cool. Never seen that before, that’s for sure. So what’s for dinner?’
Thus, with excitement bubbling in his chest, he glanced at the income statistic.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Income
paragraphs: Kaiden’s eyes locked onto the system interface the moment the number updated.
His breath hitched.
What?
No outward reaction betrayed his internal shock, but inside, his chest felt like it was swelling to the point of rupture. He couldn’t even blink. The number stared back at him, cold and final.
4,541 Chronos.
He swallowed hard.
That’s...
An increase of 4,300 Chronos.
430,000 dollars.
In twelve hours.
From a single video.
It was insanity.
Pure, beautiful, world-altering insanity.
